guide.summary: A Chinese verb names only the attempt: 找 is 'look for', 看 is 'look', 听 is 'listen'. To say what came of it you glue a result word straight onto the verb: 找到 found, 看见 saw, 听懂 understood, 做完 finished. Verb + result behaves as one word: nothing goes between them, 了 and the object come after both, and 'it did not turn out' is 没.

subs.label: 完 / 好 / 会: finished, ready, mastered
subs.focus: Choose 完 (reached the end, used up), 好 (done properly, ready) or 会 (learned, can now do it) from a cue that forces one, or see that a bare verb is not enough. Mistakes: verb + 了 for 'finished' or 'learned to'; 会 after non-learning verbs. Don't make 完 and 好 compete where both work (做完 / 做好作业).

subs.label: 见 / 到 / 懂: saw, got, understood
subs.focus: Pick the result for the meaning after 看 听 找 买 收: 见 (registered), 到 (reached the target: found, got), 懂 (understood), versus 完 or the bare verb. Mistakes: 看了 / 找了 for 'saw' / 'found', 看见 for 'understood', 找见. Never make 看见 and 看到 (or 听见 and 听到) compete: they are interchangeable.

subs.label: 错 / 对 / 清楚 / 干净: how it came out
subs.focus: Attach 错, 对, 清楚 or 干净 straight after the verb (写错, 猜对, 听清楚, 洗干净) and pick the one that fits the cue. Mistakes: English order (错写), 写了错, inserting 得 or 很, and 听懂 where the problem is hearing clearly (听清楚), not understanding.

subs.label: 住 / 开 / 掉 / 走 / 光 / 着: fixed, apart, gone
subs.focus: Choose 住 (held, stopped: 记住), 开 (open, apart: 打开), 掉 (got rid of: 扔掉), 走 (taken away: 拿走), 光 (none left: 花光) or 着 zháo (succeeded: 睡着). Mistakes: bare 记 for 'keep in mind', 睡觉着 or 睡了 for 'fell asleep', 走 and 掉 swapped, 着 read as zhe.

subs.label: 给 / 在 / 成: to someone, at a place, into something
subs.focus: 给, 在, 成 need the receiver, place or new form right after them (送给他, 放在桌子上, 翻译成中文), so the thing acted on goes in front with 把 or as topic. Learner picks which of the three and places the object. Mistakes: 放书在桌子上, 翻译这句话成中文, 了 between the verb and 给 / 在 / 成.

subs.label: 没 + verb + result
subs.focus: A result that did not happen (yet) takes 没 / 还没 before the whole verb + result, with no 了. Mistakes: 不听懂 for a past event, 没…了, 听没懂. Also: 不 + verb + result only for 'if not', refusal, habit; 听不懂 is 'cannot', not 'did not'. Make the time frame explicit so only one of 没 / 不 fits.

subs.label: Object after the whole verb + result
subs.focus: The object follows verb + result as a unit or is fronted (topic or 把); it never splits them. Verb-object words take the result after the verb part: 吃完饭, 洗完澡, 上完课. Mistakes: 看书完了, 吃饭完, 睡觉着了. Best as order and judge items; list every correct topic-first order in alts.

subs.label: 了 after verb + result
subs.focus: 了 goes after the result or at the end of the sentence, never between verb and result: 听懂了, 写完了作业, 写完作业了. First of two actions in a row (吃完饭就走) usually has no 了. Mistakes: 写了完, 听了懂, 找了到. Don't make 写完了作业 and 写完作业了 compete; both are correct.

subs.label: Asking about a result: …了吗 / …了没有
subs.focus: Form yes-no questions with verb + result + 了吗 / 了没有; answer verb + result + 了 or (还)没 + verb + result. Mistakes: 你不听懂吗 for a past event, 你听懂没有了, answering 是 / 不, answering 没听懂了. Don't mark 你听没听懂 or 你有没有听懂 wrong: both are in common use.

rules.rule: 完 says the action reached its end or the thing is used up. 好 says it is done properly and ready. 会 says you learned it and can now do it; it follows 学 (and a few verbs like 练).
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 完 / 好 / 会 + (Object) + 了

examples.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn wán le
examples.en: I've finished reading this book.

examples.py: fàn zuò hǎo le kuài lái chī ba
examples.en: The food is ready, come and eat.

examples.py: wǒ xué huì kāi chē le
examples.en: I've learned to drive.

examples.py: nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma
examples.en: Are you ready?

rules.note: 完 and 好 often both fit (作业做完了 / 作业做好了). 完 only says you reached the end; 好 adds that it is in a satisfactory, usable state. 准备, 想, 说 (in the sense of 'agree') and 放 normally take 好, not 完.

rules.rule: 见: the sight or sound registered; only with perception verbs (看见, 听见). 到: the action reached its target, with almost any verb (找到 found, 买到 got, 收到 received). 懂: you understood what you read or heard.
rules.pattern: Subject + 看 / 听 / 找 / 买 / 收 + 见 / 到 / 懂 + Object + 了

examples.zh: 我在路上看见李老师了。
examples.py: wǒ zài lù shàng kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī le
examples.en: I saw Teacher Li on the street.

examples.py: wǒ zhǎo dào shǒu jī le
examples.en: I found my phone.

examples.py: tā shuō de huà wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le
examples.en: I understood everything he said.

examples.py: nǐ de xìn wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le
examples.en: I received your letter yesterday.

rules.note: 看见 and 看到 mean the same for 'saw', and so do 听见 and 听到. But 见 cannot replace 到 after other verbs: 找到, 买到, 收到 only.

rules.rule: The bare verb is only the attempt. 看 look, 听 listen, 找 look for; add the result to say it worked. One verb takes different results for different meanings: 看见 saw, 看懂 understood, 看完 read to the end.
rules.pattern: Verb + 了 + 半天 / 很久，没 + Verb + Result

examples.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān méi zhǎo dào
examples.en: I looked for ages and didn't find it.

examples.zh: 这本书我看完了，可是没看懂。
examples.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn wán le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
examples.en: I finished this book, but I didn't understand it.

examples.py: nǐ shuō shén me wǒ méi tīng jiàn
examples.en: What did you say? I didn't hear.

rules.rule: To say an action came out wrong, right, clear or clean, put the adjective directly after the verb. No 得, no 很, and the adjective never goes in front as in English 'wrongly wrote'.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 错 / 对 / 清楚 / 干净 + (Object) + 了

examples.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ dǎ cuò diàn huà le
examples.en: Sorry, I dialled the wrong number.

examples.py: zhè gè wèn tí nǐ dá duì le
examples.en: You got this question right.

examples.zh: 我没听清楚，请再说一遍。
examples.py: wǒ méi tīng qīng chu qǐng zài shuō yī biàn
examples.en: I didn't hear clearly, please say it again.

examples.py: yī fu dōu xǐ gān jìng le
examples.en: The clothes have all been washed clean.

rules.note: 没听清楚 is a hearing problem (noise, speed); 没听懂 is an understanding problem. 洗得很干净 with 得 is a different pattern that describes how well, not what resulted.

rules.rule: 住 means held in place or stopped; 开 means open or apart; 着 (read zháo) means the action hit its mark, most often in 睡着 'fall asleep'.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 住 / 开 / 着 + (Object) + 了

examples.py: qǐng jì zhù wǒ de diàn huà hào mǎ
examples.en: Please remember my phone number.

examples.py: qǐng dà jiā dǎ kāi shū
examples.en: Everyone, please open your books.

examples.py: hái zi yǐ jīng shuì zháo le
examples.en: The child is already asleep.

examples.py: jǐng chá jiào tā zhàn zhù
examples.en: The police officer told him to stop.

rules.note: 找着 and 买着 (zháo) are colloquial equivalents of 找到 and 买到, heard mostly in the north; 到 is always safe. 睡着 cannot be replaced by 睡到.

rules.rule: 掉 means the thing is removed or got rid of; 走 means it leaves with someone; 光 means nothing is left.
rules.pattern: Subject + (把 + Object) + Verb + 掉 / 走 / 光 + 了

examples.py: zhè xiē jiù dōng xi dōu rēng diào ba
examples.en: Let's throw all these old things away.

examples.zh: 他把我的自行车骑走了。
examples.py: tā bǎ wǒ de zì xíng chē qí zǒu le
examples.en: He rode off on my bike.

examples.py: zhè gè yuè de qián dōu huā guāng le
examples.en: This month's money is all spent.

examples.py: dàn gāo bèi hái zi men chī guāng le
examples.en: The cake was eaten up by the children.

rules.note: 吃完 and 吃光 can both mean 'ate it all'; 光 stresses that not a bit is left, and 吃完 can also just mean 'finished eating'. 吃掉 and 喝掉 are also common for 'eat up, drink up'.

rules.rule: 给 (to a receiver), 在 (ending up at a place) and 成 (turning into something) must be followed at once by the receiver, the place or the new form. Move the thing acted on to the front with 把 or as a topic.
rules.pattern: Subject + 把 + Thing + Verb + 给 / 在 / 成 + Receiver / Place / New form + (了)

examples.py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū huán gěi tā le
examples.en: I gave that book back to him.

examples.py: nǐ bǎ bāo fàng zài zhuō zi shàng ba
examples.en: Just put your bag on the table.

examples.zh: 请把这句话翻译成中文。
examples.py: qǐng bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì chéng zhōng wén
examples.en: Please translate this sentence into Chinese.

examples.zh: 朋友送给我一张电影票。
examples.py: péng you sòng gěi wǒ yī zhāng diàn yǐng piào
examples.en: A friend gave me a film ticket.

rules.note: With 给 the thing may also follow the receiver (送给我一张票). With 在 and 成 it cannot follow, so 把 or a topic is needed. 了 goes at the end of the sentence or right after 给 / 成, never between the verb and 给 / 在 / 成.

rules.rule: A result that did not come about, or has not yet, is negated with 没 (还没) in front of the whole verb + result, and 了 disappears.

examples.py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ méi tīng dǒng
examples.en: I didn't understand yesterday's class.

examples.py: wǒ hái méi zuò wán zuò yè
examples.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.

examples.py: tā méi kàn jiàn wǒ
examples.en: He didn't see me.

rules.note: 听不懂 (with 不 in the middle) is a different pattern meaning 'cannot understand'. For one past occasion say 没听懂.

rules.rule: 不 before verb + result is not past: it is used for 'if you don't…', for refusing or not intending to, and for habits.

examples.zh: 不做完作业，不能看电视。
examples.py: bù zuò wán zuò yè bù néng kàn diàn shì
examples.en: No TV unless you finish your homework.

examples.zh: 你不说清楚，我怎么知道？
examples.py: nǐ bù shuō qīng chu wǒ zěn me zhī dào
examples.en: If you don't say it clearly, how would I know?

examples.py: tā chī fàn cháng cháng bù chī wán
examples.en: He often doesn't finish his food.

rules.rule: Verb + result is one unit. The object comes after both, or goes to the front as the topic; it never stands between them. With verb-object words like 吃饭, 洗澡, 上课, the result follows the verb part only.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + Result + Object + (了)   or   Object + Subject + Verb + Result + 了

examples.py: wǒ kàn wán nà běn shū le
examples.en: I've finished that book.

examples.py: jīn tiān de zuò yè wǒ xiě wán le
examples.en: I've finished today's homework.

examples.zh: 我们吃完饭去看电影吧。
examples.py: wǒ men chī wán fàn qù kàn diàn yǐng ba
examples.en: Let's go and see a film after we eat.

examples.py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào
examples.en: I'll go to bed as soon as I've had a shower.

rules.note: 睡觉 drops 觉 with a result: 睡着了, not 睡觉着了 or 睡着觉了. Long or specific objects sound most natural at the front or with 把.

rules.rule: 了 follows the result, never the bare verb. With an object, 了 may come right after the result or at the end of the sentence.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + Result + 了 + (Object)   or   Subject + Verb + Result + Object + 了

examples.py: wǒ tīng dǒng le
examples.en: I understood.

examples.py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng piào
examples.en: I managed to get two tickets.

examples.py: tā zhǎo dào gōng zuò le
examples.en: He's found a job.

examples.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù zhǎo nǐ
examples.en: I'll come and find you as soon as I've eaten.

rules.note: With a counted object, 了 right after the result is usual (买到了两张票). With a plain object, sentence-final 了 is most common in speech (找到工作了). In 'after A, do B', 完 normally carries no 了 (吃完饭就去).

rules.rule: Ask whether a result came about with 了吗 or 了没有 at the end. Answer with verb + result + 了, or 没 + verb + result (还没 for 'not yet').
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + Result + (Object) + 了吗 / 了没有？

examples.py: nǐ tīng dǒng le ma
examples.en: Did you understand?

examples.py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè le méi yǒu
examples.en: Have you finished your homework?

examples.py: nǐ de shǒu jī zhǎo dào le méi yǒu
examples.en: Have you found your phone?

examples.py: hái méi zhǎo dào
examples.en: Not yet.

rules.note: 你听没听懂？ and 你有没有听懂？ are also widely used; the 了没有 and 了吗 forms are the ones to produce first.

right.py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ méi tīng dǒng

contrasts.why: A result that failed to happen on a past occasion is negated with 没. 不听懂 is not a way to say 'didn't understand'.

right.py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào shǒu jī

contrasts.why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so the 了 of 找到了 is dropped.
看完 is one unit; the object 书 comes after it, not between 看 and 完.

right.py: wǒ xiě wán zuò yè le

contrasts.why: 了 never goes between the verb and its result. It follows 完 or ends the sentence.

contrasts.wrong: 我昨天在公园看了小王。

right.zh: 我昨天在公园看见小王了。
right.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài gōng yuán kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng le
right.en: I saw Xiao Wang in the park yesterday.

contrasts.why: 看 alone is 'look at' or 'visit'. English 'saw' is a result, so it needs 看见 or 看到.

contrasts.wrong: 我找了我的钥匙，太好了！

right.py: wǒ zhǎo dào yào shi le tài hǎo le

contrasts.why: 找 is 'look for'. 'Found' is 找到: the search reached its target.

contrasts.wrong: 他太累了，很快就睡觉着了。

right.zh: 他太累了，很快就睡着了。
right.py: tā tài lèi le hěn kuài jiù shuì zháo le
right.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep very quickly.

contrasts.why: The result attaches to the verb 睡, and 觉 is dropped: 睡着 (zháo) is 'fall asleep'.

right.py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
right.en: I put the book on the table.

contrasts.why: 放在 must be followed at once by the place, so the book moves in front with 把.

contrasts.wrong: 对不起，我错写了你的名字。

right.zh: 对不起，我写错了你的名字。
right.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ xiě cuò le nǐ de míng zi
right.en: Sorry, I wrote your name wrong.

contrasts.why: The result 错 comes after the verb. English 'wrongly wrote' order does not work.

right.py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè le méi yǒu

contrasts.why: In this question form 了 comes first and 没有 is the last word of the sentence.

cheat: English verb already contains the outcome (saw, found, heard, understood, finished)? Chinese needs verb + result: 看见, 找到, 听见, 听懂, 做完.
Verb and result are glued: no 了, no object, no 得 between them.
Didn't or hasn't yet: 没 + verb + result, and no 了. 不 + verb + result only for 'if not', refusals and habits.
Object goes after the pair (看完书) or to the front (书看完了); 吃饭 becomes 吃完饭, 睡觉 becomes 睡着.
给 / 在 / 成 want their receiver, place or new form right behind them, so use 把 for the thing.
Pick by meaning: 完 the end, 好 ready, 会 can now do it, 见 registered, 到 reached, 懂 understood, 住 fixed, 掉 gone, 走 taken away, 光 none left.
Question: …了吗 or …了没有, answered 听懂了 or 没听懂, never 是 or 不.

items.q: 我今天的作业已经写___了。
items.zh: 我今天的作业已经写完了。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān de zuò yè yǐ jīng xiě wán le
items.en: I have already finished writing today's homework.
items.why: 写完 says the writing reached its end. 会 is for a skill you have learned, and 见 and 懂 belong to seeing, hearing and understanding.

items.q: 妈妈，饭做___了，可以吃了。
items.zh: 妈妈，饭做好了，可以吃了。
items.py: mā ma fàn zuò hǎo le kě yǐ chī le
items.en: Mum, the food is ready, we can eat now.
items.why: 好 says the food is done properly and ready to eat. 会 would mean she has learned how to cook, which does not fit a meal that can be eaten now.

items.q: 我学了三个月，终于学___游泳了。
items.zh: 我学了三个月，终于学会游泳了。
items.py: wǒ xué le sān gè yuè zhōng yú xué huì yóu yǒng le
items.en: After three months of lessons, I finally learned to swim.
items.why: 学 plus 会 means you studied until you can do it. 见 is only for seeing and hearing, and 到 and 住 say nothing about acquiring a skill.

items.q: 会议材料我已经准备___了，明天可以用。
items.zh: 会议材料我已经准备好了，明天可以用。
items.py: huì yì cái liào wǒ yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo le míng tiān kě yǐ yòng
items.en: I have the meeting materials ready; we can use them tomorrow.
items.why: 准备 takes 好 to say everything is ready for use. 会 and 懂 are about skill and understanding, not about materials being prepared.

items.q: 这个软件很简单，我看一遍就学___了。
items.zh: 这个软件很简单，我看一遍就学会了。
items.py: zhè gè ruǎn jiàn hěn jiǎn dān wǒ kàn yī biàn jiù xué huì le
items.en: This software is easy; I learned how to use it after one read-through.
items.why: The point is that I can now use it, and 学会 is exactly that. 完 only says the studying ended, and 着 (zháo) cannot follow 学 here.

items.q: 这个月的销售数据我们终于整理___了，请大家过来看看。
items.zh: 这个月的销售数据我们终于整理好了，请大家过来看看。
items.py: zhè gè yuè de xiāo shòu shù jù wǒ men zhōng yú zhěng lǐ hǎo le qǐng dà jiā guò lái kàn kàn
items.en: We have finally got this month's sales figures sorted out; please come and take a look.
items.why: 整理好 means the figures are in order and ready to be looked at. 会 and 懂 describe learning and understanding, not the state of the data.

items.q: 我们的课十一点半才上___。
items.zh: 我们的课十一点半才上完。
items.py: wǒ men de kè shí yī diǎn bàn cái shàng wán
items.en: Our class doesn't end until half past eleven.
items.why: 上完 means the class reaches its end. 会 and 好 do not say that a lesson is over, and 上到 would need a stopping point after it, such as a page.

items.q: 这个星期的事情太多了，我一直到晚上九点才忙___。
items.zh: 这个星期的事情太多了，我一直到晚上九点才忙完。
items.py: zhè gè xīng qī de shì qing tài duō le wǒ yī zhí dào wǎn shang jiǔ diǎn cái máng wán
items.en: There was so much to do this week that I wasn't through with work until nine in the evening.
items.why: 忙完 means the busy stretch reached its end. 好 would claim the work was done properly, and 会 and 着 do not combine with 忙.

items.q: 我找了半天，终于找___了我的笔。
items.zh: 我找了半天，终于找到了我的笔。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào le wǒ de bǐ
items.en: After searching for ages I finally found my pen.
items.why: The search reached its target, so 找到. 懂 is for understanding, and 完 and 会 do not mean 'found'.

items.q: 老师说得太快了，我没听___。
items.zh: 老师说得太快了，我没听懂。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō de tài kuài le wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: The teacher spoke too fast and I didn't understand.
items.why: The problem is understanding, so 听懂. 听见 would mean the sound did not reach me at all, which is not the complaint when someone speaks too fast.

items.q: 同事在门口叫我，可是我戴着耳机，没听___。
items.zh: 同事在门口叫我，可是我戴着耳机，没听见。
items.py: tóng shì zài mén kǒu jiào wǒ kě shì wǒ dài zhe ěr jī méi tīng jiàn
items.en: A colleague called me from the doorway, but I had headphones on and didn't hear.
items.why: The sound never registered because of the headphones, so 听见. 听懂 would be about failing to understand words that were heard.

items.q: 这封邮件我昨天下午就收___了。
items.zh: 这封邮件我昨天下午就收到了。
items.py: zhè fēng yóu jiàn wǒ zuó tiān xià wǔ jiù shōu dào le
items.en: I already received this email yesterday afternoon.
items.why: 收 gets 到 for 'received', since the item reached me. 见 only follows perception verbs like 看 and 听, and 会 and 懂 do not fit 收.

items.q: 下课以后，我在图书馆门口看___李老师了，他还跟我打招呼。
items.zh: 下课以后，我在图书馆门口看见李老师了，他还跟我打招呼。
items.py: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ zài tú shū guǎn mén kǒu kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī le tā hái gēn wǒ dǎ zhāo hu
items.en: After class I saw Teacher Li at the library door, and he even said hello.
items.why: 'Saw' a person is 看见. 看懂 means understood what you read, and 看完 means read to the end, neither of which fits a person.

items.q: 这篇文章太难了，我看了三遍还是没看___。
items.zh: 这篇文章太难了，我看了三遍还是没看懂。
items.py: zhè piān wén zhāng tài nán le wǒ kàn le sān biàn hái shi méi kàn dǒng
items.en: This article is so hard that I still didn't understand it after reading it three times.
items.why: Reading something difficult without getting it is 没看懂. 看见 only means the eyes registered something, and 看到 or 看好 do not mean understood.

items.q: 我想买那本词典，可是跑了三家书店都没买___。
items.zh: 我想买那本词典，可是跑了三家书店都没买到。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi nà běn cí diǎn kě shì pǎo le sān jiā shū diàn dōu méi mǎi dào
items.en: I wanted that dictionary, but I went to three bookshops and couldn't get a copy.
items.why: 买到 means the buying reached its goal: you actually got it. 买见 does not exist, and 懂 and 会 are about understanding and skill.

items.q: 经理昨天发的通知，你们都收___了吗？
items.zh: 经理昨天发的通知，你们都收到了吗？
items.py: jīng lǐ zuó tiān fā de tōng zhī nǐ men dōu shōu dào le ma
items.en: Did you all receive the notice the manager sent yesterday?
items.why: A notice that was sent is 收到 once it arrives. 收完 would mean finished collecting something, and 会 and 懂 do not go with 收.

items.q: 他说的是方言，我们一句也没听___，只好请小李帮忙翻译。
items.zh: 他说的是方言，我们一句也没听懂，只好请小李帮忙翻译。
items.py: tā shuō de shì fāng yán wǒ men yī jù yě méi tīng dǒng zhǐ hǎo qǐng xiǎo lǐ bāng máng fān yì
items.en: He was speaking a dialect and we didn't understand a word, so we had to ask Xiao Li to translate.
items.why: Needing a translator means the words were heard but not understood, so 没听懂. 没听见 would say no sound reached us, which does not call for translation.

items.q: 对不起，我把你的名字写___了。
items.zh: 对不起，我把你的名字写错了。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ bǎ nǐ de míng zi xiě cuò le
items.en: Sorry, I wrote your name wrong.
items.why: The apology tells us the writing went wrong, so 写错. 写对 would mean it came out right, which contradicts 对不起.

items.q: 这道题很难，不过我这次答___了。
items.zh: 这道题很难，不过我这次答对了。
items.py: zhè dào tí hěn nán bú guò wǒ zhè cì dá duì le
items.en: This question was hard, but I got it right this time.
items.why: 不过 turns the hard question into a success, so 答对. 答错 would continue the difficulty rather than contrast with it, and 懂 and 会 do not follow 答.

items.q: 字太小了，我戴着眼镜也没看___。
items.zh: 字太小了，我戴着眼镜也没看清楚。
items.py: zì tài xiǎo le wǒ dài zhe yǎn jìng yě méi kàn qīng chu
items.en: The writing was so small I couldn't see it clearly even with glasses on.
items.why: Small print is a problem of seeing clearly, so 看清楚. 干净 is for cleaning verbs, and 对 and 完 do not describe how clearly something was seen.

items.q: 衣服太脏了，要多洗几遍才能洗___。
items.zh: 衣服太脏了，要多洗几遍才能洗干净。
items.py: yī fu tài zāng le yào duō xǐ jǐ biàn cái néng xǐ gān jìng
items.en: The clothes are so dirty they need several washes to come out clean.
items.why: Dirty clothes need to end up clean, so 洗干净. 清楚 is for sight and hearing, and 洗完 would only say the washing ended, not that the dirt is gone.

items.q: 不好意思，我发___邮件了，应该发给王经理。
items.zh: 不好意思，我发错邮件了，应该发给王经理。
items.py: bù hǎo yì si wǒ fā cuò yóu jiàn le yīng gāi fā gěi wáng jīng lǐ
items.en: Sorry, I sent the wrong email; it should have gone to Manager Wang.
items.why: The second clause says it should have gone elsewhere, so the sending went wrong: 发错. 发对 would contradict the apology.

items.q: 请把黑板擦___，下节课要用。
items.zh: 请把黑板擦干净，下节课要用。
items.py: qǐng bǎ hēi bǎn cā gān jìng xià jié kè yào yòng
items.en: Please wipe the board clean; we need it for the next class.
items.why: 擦干净 means the board ends up clean. 会, 懂 and 着 are not results of wiping.

items.q: 电话里信号不好，我没听___他说什么，只好请他再说一遍。
items.zh: 电话里信号不好，我没听清楚他说什么，只好请他再说一遍。
items.py: diàn huà lǐ xìn hào bù hǎo wǒ méi tīng qīng chu tā shuō shén me zhǐ hǎo qǐng tā zài shuō yī biàn
items.en: The signal on the phone was bad and I couldn't hear clearly what he said, so I asked him to repeat it.
items.why: A bad signal makes the sound unclear, so 没听清楚. 干净 is for cleaning, 对 is for right and wrong answers, and 没听完 would mean he had not finished.

items.q: 请大家记___明天考试的时间。
items.zh: 请大家记住明天考试的时间。
items.py: qǐng dà jiā jì zhù míng tiān kǎo shì de shí jiān
items.en: Everyone, please remember the time of tomorrow's exam.
items.why: 记住 means to fix it in your memory. 掉, 走 and 光 mean removed, taken away and used up, which is the opposite of keeping it in mind.

items.q: 昨天晚上我太累了，一躺下就睡___了。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我太累了，一躺下就睡着了。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ tài lèi le yī tǎng xià jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: I was so tired last night that I fell asleep as soon as I lay down.
items.why: 睡着 (zháo) is 'fall asleep'. 睡好 would mean slept well, which does not match 'as soon as I lay down'.

items.q: 教室里太热了，请把窗户打___。
items.zh: 教室里太热了，请把窗户打开。
items.py: jiào shì lǐ tài rè le qǐng bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi
items.en: It is too hot in the classroom; please open the window.
items.why: 打开 means to open something up. 掉 and 走 mean removed and taken away, and 住 means held fixed, none of which opens a window.

items.q: 这些旧文件没有用了，都扔___吧。
items.zh: 这些旧文件没有用了，都扔掉吧。
items.py: zhè xiē jiù wén jiàn méi yǒu yòng le dōu rēng diào ba
items.en: These old files are useless, so just throw them all away.
items.why: 扔掉 means to throw something away and be rid of it. 扔开 would be to throw it apart or aside, and 扔住 would mean to hold it.

items.q: 同事把我的笔借___了，现在我没有笔用。
items.zh: 同事把我的笔借走了，现在我没有笔用。
items.py: tóng shì bǎ wǒ de bǐ jiè zǒu le xiàn zài wǒ méi yǒu bǐ yòng
items.en: A colleague has borrowed my pen and gone off with it, so now I have no pen to use.
items.why: 借走 means the pen was borrowed and taken away by someone. 借掉 is not used, since 掉 means getting rid of something.

items.q: 这个月的钱我都花___了，下个月只能省着点儿。
items.zh: 这个月的钱我都花光了，下个月只能省着点儿。
items.py: zhè gè yuè de qián wǒ dōu huā guāng le xià gè yuè zhǐ néng shěng zhe diǎn r
items.en: I've spent all of this month's money; next month I'll have to economize.
items.why: 花光 means none is left, which explains the need to economize. 花走 and 花开 are not used, and 花住 would not mean spending.

items.q: 经理说得太快，我一下子没记___。
items.zh: 经理说得太快，我一下子没记住。
items.py: jīng lǐ shuō de tài kuài wǒ yī xià zi méi jì zhù
items.en: The manager spoke so fast that I couldn't take it all in and remember it at once.
items.why: 没记住 means it did not stay in my memory. 光 and 走 mean used up and taken away, and 开 means open, so none of them fits.

items.q: 昨天晚上我因为咖啡喝多了，一直没睡___。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我因为咖啡喝多了，一直没睡着。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ yīn wèi kā fēi hē duō le yī zhí méi shuì zháo
items.en: Last night I'd had too much coffee and couldn't fall asleep.
items.why: Too much coffee stops you falling asleep: 没睡着 (zháo). 睡完 and 睡会 are not used, and 睡住 means nothing.

items.q: 小王把桌子上的零食全吃___了，一点儿都没给我留。
items.zh: 小王把桌子上的零食全吃光了，一点儿都没给我留。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bǎ zhuō zi shàng de líng shí quán chī guāng le yī diǎn r dōu méi gěi wǒ liú
items.en: Xiao Wang ate all the snacks on the table and left me nothing.
items.why: 吃光 stresses that nothing is left, which the second clause confirms. 吃走 is not used, and 住 and 开 do not mean eaten up.

items.q: 警察对他喊了一声，他马上站___了。
items.zh: 警察对他喊了一声，他马上站住了。
items.py: jǐng chá duì tā hǎn le yī shēng tā mǎ shàng zhàn zhù le
items.en: The policeman called out to him and he stopped on the spot.
items.why: 站住 means stand still, stop moving. 站开 is not used, and 站掉 and 站着 do not mean stopping.

items.q: 我把课本放___书包里了。
items.zh: 我把课本放在书包里了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ kè běn fàng zài shū bāo lǐ le
items.en: I put my textbook in my school bag.
items.why: The book ends up in a place, so 放在 plus the place. 给 needs a person to receive it, 成 needs a new form, and 放走 would mean it was taken away.

items.q: 请把这份中文报告翻译___英文，下午交给经理。
items.zh: 请把这份中文报告翻译成英文，下午交给经理。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn zhōng wén bào gào fān yì chéng yīng wén xià wǔ jiāo gěi jīng lǐ
items.en: Please translate this Chinese report into English and hand it to the manager this afternoon.
items.why: Turning one language into another is 翻译成. 给 needs a receiver and 在 a place, and English is neither.

items.q: 小李把会议时间写___白板上了。
items.zh: 小李把会议时间写在白板上了。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ huì yì shí jiān xiě zài bái bǎn shàng le
items.en: Xiao Li wrote the meeting time on the whiteboard.
items.why: The time ends up on the board, a place, so 写在. 给 would need a person receiving it, and 成 a new form.

items.q: 我把会议资料发___每个同事了。
items.zh: 我把会议资料发给每个同事了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ huì yì zī liào fā gěi měi gè tóng shì le
items.en: I sent the meeting materials to every colleague.
items.why: Sending to people is 发给 plus the receiver. 在 is for places, and 成 and 着 do not fit a recipient.

items.q: 他把一百块钱换___了美元。
items.zh: 他把一百块钱换成了美元。
items.py: tā bǎ yī bǎi kuài qián huàn chéng le měi yuán
items.en: He changed a hundred yuan into US dollars.
items.why: Money turning into another currency is 换成 plus the new form. 换给 would need a person, and 换住 and 换走 do not give a new form.

items.q: 对不起，我还___做完这个报告。
items.zh: 对不起，我还没做完这个报告。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ hái méi zuò wán zhè gè bào gào
items.en: Sorry, I haven't finished this report yet.
items.why: A result that has not happened yet takes 没, as in 还没做完. 不 is for refusing or habits, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 我上课的时候一直在看手机，所以___听懂老师的话。
items.zh: 我上课的时候一直在看手机，所以没听懂老师的话。
items.py: wǒ shàng kè de shí hou yī zhí zài kàn shǒu jī suǒ yǐ méi tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà
items.en: I kept looking at my phone in class, so I didn't understand what the teacher said.
items.why: This is one past occasion, so 没听懂. 不听懂 is not a way to say 'did not understand'.

items.q: 小王今天早上___找到他的钥匙，所以迟到了。
items.zh: 小王今天早上没找到他的钥匙，所以迟到了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng jīn tiān zǎo shang méi zhǎo dào tā de yào shi suǒ yǐ chí dào le
items.en: Xiao Wang couldn't find his keys this morning, so he was late.
items.why: The search failed on one past morning, so 没找到. 不找到 would be a refusal or a condition, and 别 is an order.

items.q: 昨天晚上我没看完___那本书，今天接着看。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我没看完那本书，今天接着看。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ méi kàn wán nà běn shū jīn tiān jiē zhe kàn
items.en: I didn't finish that book last night, so I'm carrying on with it today.
items.why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 cannot follow 看完. 过 and 着 do not belong either.

items.q: 我还没写完___作业，不能出去玩。
items.zh: 我还没写完作业，不能出去玩。
items.py: wǒ hái méi xiě wán zuò yè bù néng chū qù wán
items.en: I haven't finished my homework yet, so I can't go out to play.
items.why: With 还没 the result has not happened, so the verb gets no 了: 还没写完作业. 了 would clash with 没.

items.q: 你的作业做完___没有？
items.zh: 你的作业做完了没有？
items.py: nǐ de zuò yè zuò wán le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you finished your homework?
items.why: The 了没有 question asks whether the result has come about, so 了 follows 做完 and 没有 closes the sentence. 过 would ask about a past experience.

items.q: 经理要的报告你写___了吗？
items.zh: 经理要的报告你写完了吗？
items.py: jīng lǐ yào de bào gào nǐ xiě wán le ma
items.en: Have you finished writing the report the manager asked for?
items.why: Asking whether writing reached its end is 写完了吗. 写会 is not used, 写着 would read as zhe, and 写掉 would mean writing it off.

items.q: 老师，您有没有收___我昨天发的邮件？
items.zh: 老师，您有没有收到我昨天发的邮件？
items.py: lǎo shī nín yǒu méi yǒu shōu dào wǒ zuó tiān fā de yóu jiàn
items.en: Teacher, did you get the email I sent yesterday?
items.why: Receiving an email is 收到, and 有没有 plus the verb-result is a standard question form. 收见 does not exist, and 会 and 懂 do not go with 收.

items.q: 我买到___两张去北京的票，明天出发。
items.zh: 我买到了两张去北京的票，明天出发。
items.py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng qù běi jīng de piào míng tiān chū fā
items.en: I managed to get two tickets to Beijing and we leave tomorrow.
items.why: With a counted object, 了 sits right after the result: 买到了两张票. 过 would mean a past experience, which clashes with leaving tomorrow.

items.q: 他找到___工作，很高兴。
items.zh: 他找到了工作，很高兴。
items.py: tā zhǎo dào le gōng zuò hěn gāo xìng
items.en: He found a job and is very happy.
items.why: A completed result takes 了 right after the result 找到. 过 would mean he found one once in the past, which does not explain why he is happy now.

items.zh: 他没听懂老师的话。
items.py: tā méi tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà
items.en: He didn't understand what the teacher said.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 听懂, and the object comes after it or is fronted as the topic. 他听没懂 splits the result from its verb.

items.zh: 请打开你们的书。
items.py: qǐng dǎ kāi nǐ men de shū
items.en: Please open your books.
items.why: 打开 is one unit and the object follows it. 请 opens the polite command.

items.zh: 我把书放在桌子上。
items.py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: I put the book on the table.
items.why: 在桌子上 must follow 放 at once, so the book moves in front of the verb with 把.

items.zh: 请把这份报告翻译成英文。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn bào gào fān yì chéng yīng wén
items.en: Please translate this report into English.
items.why: 成 needs the new form straight after it, so the report goes in front with 把 and 翻译成英文 stays together.

items.zh: 同事把会议资料发给每个人了。
items.py: tóng shì bǎ huì yì zī liào fā gěi měi gè rén le
items.en: The colleague sent the meeting materials to everyone.
items.why: 给每个人 follows the verb at once, and the materials go after 把. 了 comes last.

items.zh: 我们吃完饭就去开会。
items.py: wǒ men chī wán fàn jiù qù kāi huì
items.en: As soon as we've eaten, we'll go to the meeting.
items.why: 吃完饭 keeps the result right after the verb and puts 饭 after it. Because it is the first of two actions, it takes no 了.

items.zh: 他洗完澡就睡觉了。
items.py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào le
items.en: He went to bed as soon as he'd had his shower.
items.why: With the verb-object 洗澡 the result follows the verb part only: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is not Chinese.

items.zh: 你做完作业了吗？
items.py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè le ma
items.en: Have you finished your homework?
items.why: 了 closes the verb-result-object chunk and 吗 turns it into a yes/no question about the result.

items.zh: 你看见我的手机了吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn jiàn wǒ de shǒu jī le ma
items.en: Have you seen my phone?
items.why: The question uses verb + result + 了 + 吗. 了 may also follow 看见 directly, but never splits 看 from 见.

items.zh: 她终于找到了满意的工作。
items.py: tā zhōng yú zhǎo dào le mǎn yì de gōng zuò
items.en: She finally found a job she was happy with.
items.why: 了 follows the result 找到, or comes at the very end. It never goes between 找 and 到.

items.zh: 我还没看完经理发的邮件。
items.py: wǒ hái méi kàn wán jīng lǐ fā de yóu jiàn
items.en: I haven't finished reading the email the manager sent.
items.why: 还没 goes in front of the whole 看完, and the long object either follows or is fronted as the topic. No 了 appears.

items.zh: 对不起，我写错了你的名字。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ xiě cuò le nǐ de míng zi
items.en: Sorry, I wrote your name wrong.
items.why: 错 comes straight after 写, and 了 follows 错 or ends the sentence. The English order 'wrongly wrote' does not exist.

items.zh: 他没看见我。
items.py: tā méi kàn jiàn wǒ
items.en: He didn't see me.
items.why: 没 goes before 看见 as a whole, and no 了 is added. The subject 他 comes first and the object 我 after the verb.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le
items.task: Say you did NOT understand.
items.zh: 我没听懂。
items.py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng
items.en: I didn't understand.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 听懂 and 了 disappears. 不听懂 is not a past negative.

items.src_py: tā kàn wán nà běn shū le
items.task: Turn it into a 了没有 question.
items.zh: 他看完那本书了没有？
items.py: tā kàn wán nà běn shū le méi yǒu
items.en: Has he finished that book?
items.why: The question keeps verb + result + object, then adds 了 and ends on 没有. The fronted topic order is also correct.

items.src_py: wǒ xiě wán le zhè fèn bào gào
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 我把这份报告写完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhè fèn bào gào xiě wán le
items.en: I've finished writing this report.
items.why: With 把 the object moves in front of the verb, and 写完 keeps 完 and takes 了 at the end.

items.src_py: wǒ sòng le nà běn cí diǎn gěi tā
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 我把那本词典送给他了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà běn cí diǎn sòng gěi tā le
items.en: I gave him that dictionary.
items.why: 把 puts the dictionary before the verb, so 给他 can follow 送 at once. 了 goes at the end.

items.src_py: wǒ xiě cuò le nǐ de míng zi
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 我把你的名字写错了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nǐ de míng zi xiě cuò le
items.en: I wrote your name wrong.
items.why: 把 fronts the object and 写错 stays together with 了 after it. 错 never moves ahead of 写.

items.src_py: wǒ hái méi zuò wán zuò yè
items.task: Say you have already done it.
items.zh: 我已经做完作业了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng zuò wán zuò yè le
items.en: I've already finished my homework.
items.why: The positive form drops 没 and adds 了 after the result or at the end. 了 may follow 做完, and the object may be fronted as a topic.

items.src_py: tā bǎ qián huā guāng le
items.task: Say he has NOT yet spent it all.
items.zh: 他还没把钱花光。
items.py: tā hái méi bǎ qián huā guāng
items.en: He hasn't spent all the money yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把 and the whole verb + result, and 了 is dropped.

items.src_py: dì di shuì zháo le
items.task: Say he is not asleep yet.
items.zh: 弟弟还没睡着。
items.py: dì di hái méi shuì zháo
items.en: My little brother isn't asleep yet.
items.why: 还没 before 睡着 means the result has not happened yet, and 了 is dropped.

items.src_py: nǐ zhǎo dào yào shi le
items.task: Make it a yes/no question with 吗.
items.zh: 你找到钥匙了吗？
items.py: nǐ zhǎo dào yào shi le ma
items.en: Have you found the key?
items.why: Verb + result + object + 了 + 吗 asks whether the result came about. Fronting the object works too.

items.src: 我昨天把那份文件发给经理了。
items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān bǎ nà fèn wén jiàn fā gěi jīng lǐ le
items.task: Say you have not yet done it (还没).
items.zh: 我还没把那份文件发给经理。
items.py: wǒ hái méi bǎ nà fèn wén jiàn fā gěi jīng lǐ
items.en: I haven't sent that document to the manager yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把 and the whole verb + result, and 了 disappears. 发给经理 stays together.

items.src_py: tóng xué men chī guāng le dàn gāo
items.task: Rewrite with 被.
items.zh: 蛋糕被同学们吃光了。
items.py: dàn gāo bèi tóng xué men chī guāng le
items.en: The cake was eaten up by the classmates.
items.why: 被 puts the cake first and the agent after 被, while 吃光 stays together before 了.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng qīng chu le
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 我没听清楚。
items.py: wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
items.en: I didn't hear clearly.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 听清楚, and 了 is dropped.

items.src_py: tā bǎ zuò yè xiě wán le
items.task: Make it negative (没).
items.zh: 他没把作业写完。
items.py: tā méi bǎ zuò yè xiě wán
items.en: He didn't finish his homework.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped, giving 没把作业写完.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn wán le zhè fēng yóu jiàn
items.task: Move 了 to the end of the sentence.
items.zh: 我看完这封邮件了。
items.py: wǒ kàn wán zhè fēng yóu jiàn le
items.en: I've finished reading this email.
items.why: 了 may follow the result or end the sentence, and either way it never separates 看 from 完. Fronting the object also works.

items.s: 我看书完了。
items.s_py: wǒ kàn shū wán le
items.zh: 我看完书了。
items.py: wǒ kàn wán shū le
items.en: I've finished reading.
items.why: 看完 is one unit, so the object 书 cannot stand between 看 and 完. It must come after 看完.

items.s: 我吃完饭就去图书馆。
items.s_py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù tú shū guǎn
items.zh: 我吃完饭就去图书馆。
items.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù tú shū guǎn
items.en: I'll go to the library as soon as I've eaten.
items.why: This is correct. In 'after A, do B', 吃完饭 normally has no 了, so the missing 了 is not an error.

items.s: 我今天早上没看见李老师。
items.s_py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang méi kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī
items.zh: 我今天早上没看见李老师。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang méi kàn jiàn lǐ lǎo shī
items.en: I didn't see Teacher Li this morning.
items.why: This is correct. 没 already says the result did not happen, so no 了 is needed after 看见.

items.s: 他很累，一躺下就睡觉着了。
items.s_py: tā hěn lèi yī tǎng xià jiù shuì jiào zháo le
items.zh: 他很累，一躺下就睡着了。
items.py: tā hěn lèi yī tǎng xià jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: He was tired and fell asleep as soon as he lay down.
items.why: The result 着 attaches to 睡 and 觉 is dropped: 睡着了. 睡觉着 is not Chinese.

items.s: 我把笔借给小王了。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ bǐ jiè gěi xiǎo wáng le
items.zh: 我把笔借给小王了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ bǐ jiè gěi xiǎo wáng le
items.en: I lent my pen to Xiao Wang.
items.why: This is correct. 借给 is followed at once by the receiver 小王, and the pen is fronted with 把.

items.s: 我写了完作业，就去打球。
items.s_py: wǒ xiě le wán zuò yè jiù qù dǎ qiú
items.zh: 我写完作业，就去打球。
items.py: wǒ xiě wán zuò yè jiù qù dǎ qiú
items.en: I'll go and play ball as soon as I've finished my homework.
items.why: 了 never goes between a verb and its result. 写完 stays together, and 了 would not be needed here anyway.

items.s: 我上课没听懂，下课以后问了老师。
items.s_py: wǒ shàng kè méi tīng dǒng xià kè yǐ hòu wèn le lǎo shī
items.zh: 我上课没听懂，下课以后问了老师。
items.py: wǒ shàng kè méi tīng dǒng xià kè yǐ hòu wèn le lǎo shī
items.en: I didn't understand in class, so I asked the teacher afterwards.
items.why: This is correct. 没听懂 needs no 了, while 问了老师 is a separate completed action with its own 了.

items.s: 对不起，我打电话错了。
items.s_py: duì bu qǐ wǒ dǎ diàn huà cuò le
items.zh: 对不起，我打错电话了。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ dǎ cuò diàn huà le
items.en: Sorry, I dialled the wrong number.
items.why: 错 is a result and must sit right after the verb: 打错. It cannot be left after the object 电话.

items.s: 经理说的话，你们都听清楚了吗？
items.s_py: jīng lǐ shuō de huà nǐ men dōu tīng qīng chu le ma
items.zh: 经理说的话，你们都听清楚了吗？
items.py: jīng lǐ shuō de huà nǐ men dōu tīng qīng chu le ma
items.en: Did you all hear clearly what the manager said?
items.why: This is correct. 听清楚 plus 了吗 is the normal question form, with the topic 经理说的话 fronted.

items.s: 这些旧资料我已经全部扔掉了，你不用再找了。
items.s_py: zhè xiē jiù zī liào wǒ yǐ jīng quán bù rēng diào le nǐ bù yòng zài zhǎo le
items.zh: 这些旧资料我已经全部扔掉了，你不用再找了。
items.py: zhè xiē jiù zī liào wǒ yǐ jīng quán bù rēng diào le nǐ bù yòng zài zhǎo le
items.en: I've already thrown out all these old materials, so you needn't look for them any more.
items.why: This is correct. 扔掉 means thrown away for good, and 了 follows the result, which fits the point that there is nothing left to find.

items.s: 他把我的蛋糕吃了光。
items.s_py: tā bǎ wǒ de dàn gāo chī le guāng
items.zh: 他把我的蛋糕吃光了。
items.py: tā bǎ wǒ de dàn gāo chī guāng le
items.en: He ate up my cake.
items.why: 吃光 is one unit and 了 cannot stand between 吃 and 光. It goes after 光.

items.s: 请你把这份文件翻译英文，下午交给我。
items.s_py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fān yì yīng wén xià wǔ jiāo gěi wǒ
items.zh: 请你把这份文件翻译成英文，下午交给我。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè fèn wén jiàn fān yì chéng yīng wén xià wǔ jiāo gěi wǒ
items.en: Please translate this document into English and give it to me this afternoon.
items.why: With 把 the verb needs a complement, and turning into another language needs 成: 翻译成英文. Bare 翻译英文 is incomplete.

items.s: 他在书店找了半天，才找到那本词典。
items.s_py: tā zài shū diàn zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào nà běn cí diǎn
items.zh: 他在书店找了半天，才找到那本词典。
items.py: tā zài shū diàn zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào nà běn cí diǎn
items.en: He searched the bookshop for ages before he found that dictionary.
items.why: This is correct. 找了半天 describes the searching, and 找到 describes the finding. Each verb carries what it needs.

items.s: 我把今天的会议材料放了在经理的桌子上。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ jīn tiān de huì yì cái liào fàng le zài jīng lǐ de zhuō zi shàng
items.zh: 我把今天的会议材料放在经理的桌子上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ jīn tiān de huì yì cái liào fàng zài jīng lǐ de zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: I put today's meeting materials on the manager's desk.
items.why: 了 cannot come between 放 and 在. It goes at the end of the sentence.

items.s: 昨天的作业太多了，我写到十二点还没写完。
items.s_py: zuó tiān de zuò yè tài duō le wǒ xiě dào shí èr diǎn hái méi xiě wán
items.zh: 昨天的作业太多了，我写到十二点还没写完。
items.py: zuó tiān de zuò yè tài duō le wǒ xiě dào shí èr diǎn hái méi xiě wán
items.en: There was so much homework yesterday that I was still writing at twelve and hadn't finished.
items.why: This is correct. 写到十二点 gives the time reached, and 还没写完 shows the result had not come about, so no 了.

items.s: 经理要的报告你写完没有了？
items.s_py: jīng lǐ yào de bào gào nǐ xiě wán méi yǒu le
items.zh: 经理要的报告你写完了没有？
items.py: jīng lǐ yào de bào gào nǐ xiě wán le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you finished writing the report the manager wanted?
items.why: In the 了没有 question, 了 comes right after 写完 and 没有 closes the sentence. 没有了 reverses them.

items.s: 他不吃完饭，妈妈就不让他出去玩。
items.s_py: tā bù chī wán fàn mā ma jiù bù ràng tā chū qù wán
items.zh: 他不吃完饭，妈妈就不让他出去玩。
items.py: tā bù chī wán fàn mā ma jiù bù ràng tā chū qù wán
items.en: If he doesn't finish his meal, his mother won't let him go out to play.
items.why: This is correct. 不 before verb + result is right for 'if not', and 不吃完饭 sets the condition for the 就 clause.

items.s: 他昨天不收到我的邮件，所以没来。
items.s_py: tā zuó tiān bù shōu dào wǒ de yóu jiàn suǒ yǐ méi lái
items.zh: 他昨天没收到我的邮件，所以没来。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi shōu dào wǒ de yóu jiàn suǒ yǐ méi lái
items.en: He didn't receive my email yesterday, so he didn't come.
items.why: 昨天 marks one past occasion, so the negative is 没收到. 不收到 is not a past negative.

items.q: 我在厨房，没听___你叫我。
items.zh: 我在厨房，没听见你叫我。
items.py: wǒ zài chú fáng méi tīng jiàn nǐ jiào wǒ
items.en: I was in the kitchen and didn't hear you call me.
items.why: 听见 means the sound registered, so 没听见 is 'did not hear'. 听懂 would mean not understood the words, and the cue is simply not hearing.

items.q: 妹妹没找到她的书包___，哭了起来。
items.zh: 妹妹没找到她的书包，哭了起来。
items.py: mèi mei méi zhǎo dào tā de shū bāo kū le qǐ lái
items.en: My sister couldn't find her school bag and started crying.
items.why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 is dropped after 找到. 没找到书包了 is not a normal sentence.

items.s: 我把那件旧衣服扔着了。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ nà jiàn jiù yī fu rēng zháo le
items.zh: 我把那件旧衣服扔掉了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà jiàn jiù yī fu rēng diào le
items.en: I threw that old garment away.
items.why: Getting rid of something takes 掉: 扔掉. 着 (zháo) means the action hit its mark, as in 睡着, and does not combine with 扔.

items.s: 他太累了，很快就睡觉着了。
items.s_py: tā tài lèi le hěn kuài jiù shuì jiào zháo le
items.zh: 他太累了，很快就睡着了。
items.py: tā tài lèi le hěn kuài jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep very quickly.
items.why: The result 着 attaches directly to 睡, and 觉 is dropped: 睡着 is 'fall asleep'. 睡觉着 splits the verb from its result.

items.src_py: wǒ ná le dì di de shū bāo
items.task: Say it was a mistake, with 把 and 错.
items.zh: 我把弟弟的书包拿错了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ dì di de shū bāo ná cuò le
items.en: I took my brother's bag by mistake.
items.why: 错 follows the verb as 拿错. English 'wrongly took' order is not used.

items.s: 请把这句话翻译中文。
items.s_py: qǐng bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì zhōng wén
items.zh: 请把这句话翻译成中文。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì chéng zhōng wén
items.en: Please translate this sentence into Chinese.
items.why: 'Into' a language needs 成: 翻译成中文. Without 成 the sentence has no way to say what the sentence turns into.

items.q: 妈妈把西瓜切___小块，给孩子们吃。
items.zh: 妈妈把西瓜切成小块，给孩子们吃。
items.py: mā ma bǎ xī guā qiē chéng xiǎo kuài gěi hái zi men chī
items.en: Mum cut the watermelon into small pieces for the children.
items.why: 切成 says what the melon turned into, small pieces. 在 and 到 would need a location, and 给 needs a person.

items.s: 我把那本书还了给他。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū huán le gěi tā
items.zh: 我把那本书还给他了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū huán gěi tā le
items.en: I gave that book back to him.
items.why: 了 cannot sit between the verb and 给; 还给 is glued. 了 goes after 他 or at the end.

items.q: 我在网上学___了做蛋糕。
items.zh: 我在网上学会了做蛋糕。
items.py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng xué huì le zuò dàn gāo
items.en: I learned how to make cakes online.
items.why: 学会 means learned to and can now do it. 学完 would only say a course ended and 学好 means studied well, so neither says 'learned how to make a cake'.

items.q: 我昨天去商店，可是___买到那条裙子。
items.zh: 我昨天去商店，可是没买到那条裙子。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qù shāng diàn kě shì méi mǎi dào nà tiáo qún zi
items.en: I went to the shop yesterday but didn't get that skirt.
items.why: A past result that did not happen is negated with 没. 不 is for habits or refusals, and 别 is an imperative.

items.q: 妈妈做___饭了，快来吃吧。
items.zh: 妈妈做好饭了，快来吃吧。
items.py: mā ma zuò hǎo fàn le kuài lái chī ba
items.en: Mum has dinner ready, come and eat.
items.why: 好 says the meal is done and ready to eat, which fits 快来吃吧. 会 means learned how to, and 到 / 见 are for reaching or perceiving, so none fits a cooked meal.

items.zh: 我昨天买到了两张票。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng piào
items.en: I managed to buy two tickets yesterday.
items.why: 了 follows the whole result 买到 and precedes the counted object. 买了到 would put 了 between verb and result.

items.src_py: wǒ mǎi dào tā le
items.task: Say you have not got it yet.
items.zh: 我还没买到它。
items.py: wǒ hái méi mǎi dào tā
items.en: I haven't got it yet.
items.why: 还没 before 买到 means not yet, and 了 is dropped.

items.q: 我昨晚太累，作业没写___，就睡着了。
items.zh: 我昨晚太累，作业没写完，就睡着了。
items.py: wǒ zuó wǎn tài lèi zuò yè méi xiě wán jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: I was so tired last night that I fell asleep without finishing my homework.
items.why: 没写完 says the homework was left unfinished, which is why falling asleep follows. 会 / 见 do not go with 写, and 没写对 would be about errors.

items.q: 你在哪里买___这么便宜的菜？
items.zh: 你在哪里买到这么便宜的菜？
items.py: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ mǎi dào zhè me pián yi de cài
items.en: Where did you manage to buy such cheap vegetables?
items.why: 买到 means succeeded in getting. 买见 does not exist because 见 only follows perception verbs, and 懂 / 会 are not results of buying.

items.q: 弟弟吃完___三个包子，还想再吃。
items.zh: 弟弟吃完了三个包子，还想再吃。
items.py: dì di chī wán le sān gè bāo zi hái xiǎng zài chī
items.en: My brother finished three buns and still wants more.
items.why: 了 goes right after the result 完 and before the counted object. 过 would mean ever did, and 着 / 的 cannot follow 吃完.

items.q: 你想___了没有，到底要买哪个？
items.zh: 你想好了没有，到底要买哪个？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng hǎo le méi yǒu dào dǐ yào mǎi nǎ gè
items.en: Have you made up your mind yet? Which one are you buying?
items.why: 想好 means has decided, which suits 到底要买哪个. 想完 would just mean finished thinking, and 会 / 见 do not go with 想.

items.src_py: wǒ chī le fàn rán hòu qù mǎi cài
items.task: Say 'as soon as I've eaten' with 吃完 and 就.
items.zh: 我吃完饭就去买菜。
items.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù mǎi cài
items.en: I'll go and buy groceries as soon as I've eaten.
items.why: 吃完饭就 is the usual 'after A, then B', with the object after 吃完 and no 了.

items.src_py: nǐ guān hǎo mén
items.task: Make it a polite request with 请 and 把.
items.zh: 请你把门关好。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ mén guān hǎo
items.en: Please shut the door properly.
items.why: 关好 stays together, and 把 puts the door in front of it.

items.q: 我想把这些美元换___人民币。
items.zh: 我想把这些美元换成人民币。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè xiē měi yuán huàn chéng rén mín bì
items.en: I want to exchange these US dollars into renminbi.
items.why: 换成 states what the money becomes, 人民币. 换给 needs a person, 换在 a place, and 换走 means swapped away.

items.q: 我在超市看___了姑姑。
items.zh: 我在超市看见了姑姑。
items.py: wǒ zài chāo shì kàn jiàn le gū gu
items.en: I saw my aunt in the supermarket.
items.why: 'Saw' is a sight that registered, so 看见. 看懂 is understood and 看完 is finished reading; neither can describe seeing a person.

items.q: 小狗跑到马路上，妈妈大声叫它站___。
items.zh: 小狗跑到马路上，妈妈大声叫它站住。
items.py: xiǎo gǒu pǎo dào mǎ lù shàng mā ma dà shēng jiào tā zhàn zhù
items.en: The puppy ran onto the road and Mum shouted for it to stop.
items.why: 站住 is the command to stop where you are. 站开 means stand apart and 掉 / 光 do not follow 站.

items.q: 客人把桌上的蛋糕都带___了。
items.zh: 客人把桌上的蛋糕都带走了。
items.py: kè rén bǎ zhuō shàng de dàn gāo dōu dài zǒu le
items.en: The guests took all the cake on the table away with them.
items.why: 带走 means carried off with someone, matching guests taking cake home. 带掉 and 带光 are not used, and 着 would be read zhe.

items.q: 弟弟还没吃___，你别把盘子拿走。
items.zh: 弟弟还没吃完，你别把盘子拿走。
items.py: dì di hái méi chī wán nǐ bié bǎ pán zi ná zǒu
items.en: My brother hasn't finished eating yet, so don't take the plate away.
items.why: 还没吃完 says eating is unfinished, a good reason not to remove the plate. 吃会 and 吃懂 are not Chinese.

items.q: 宝宝昨晚哭了很久，十一点才睡___。
items.zh: 宝宝昨晚哭了很久，十一点才睡着。
items.py: bǎo bao zuó wǎn kū le hěn jiǔ shí yī diǎn cái shuì zháo
items.en: The baby cried for a long time last night and only fell asleep at eleven.
items.why: 睡着 (zháo) is the result 'fell asleep'. 睡完 and 睡见 are not Chinese for this, and 会 never goes after 睡.

items.q: 姐姐寄的包裹我昨天收___了。
items.zh: 姐姐寄的包裹我昨天收到了。
items.py: jiě jie jì de bāo guǒ wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le
items.en: I received the parcel my sister sent yesterday.
items.why: 收到 means it reached me. 见 works only with perception verbs, and 懂 / 会 are not results of receiving.

items.q: 我想把这件毛衣送___奶奶。
items.zh: 我想把这件毛衣送给奶奶。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè jiàn máo yī sòng gěi nǎi nai
items.en: I want to give this sweater to Grandma.
items.why: 给 introduces the receiver right after the verb. 在 and 到 would need a place, and 成 would need a new form.

items.s: 你的信我昨天收到了。
items.s_py: nǐ de xìn wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le
items.zh: 你的信我昨天收到了。
items.py: nǐ de xìn wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le
items.en: I received your letter yesterday.
items.why: Correct: with the letter as topic, 收到了 closes the sentence. 到 is the result for 'received'; 收见 would be wrong.

items.src_py: dì di chī guāng le dàn gāo
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 弟弟把蛋糕吃光了。
items.py: dì di bǎ dàn gāo chī guāng le
items.en: My younger brother ate up the cake.
items.why: 把 moves the cake in front of 吃光, and 了 stays at the end. 吃光 must stay together.

items.src_py: hái zi men xǐ gān jìng le shǒu
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 孩子们把手洗干净了。
items.py: hái zi men bǎ shǒu xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: The children washed their hands clean.
items.why: 把 puts the hands before the verb, and the pair 洗干净 stays together with 了 after it.

items.q: 我学___了怎么用洗衣机，现在不用问妈妈了。
items.zh: 我学会了怎么用洗衣机，现在不用问妈妈了。
items.py: wǒ xué huì le zěn me yòng xǐ yī jī xiàn zài bù yòng wèn mā ma le
items.en: I've learned how to use the washing machine, so I don't need to ask Mum now.
items.why: 学会 is 'learned how to', explaining why asking is no longer needed. 学完 would only say studying ended and 学好 'studied well'.

items.zh: 我洗完澡就睡觉。
items.py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào
items.en: I'll go to bed as soon as I've had a shower.
items.why: With the verb-object word 洗澡, the result attaches to the verb part: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is not said.

items.s: 弟弟哭了很久，终于睡着了。
items.s_py: dì di kū le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú shuì zháo le
items.zh: 弟弟哭了很久，终于睡着了。
items.py: dì di kū le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú shuì zháo le
items.en: My brother cried for a long time and finally fell asleep.
items.why: Correct: 睡着 is the result 'fell asleep'. A bare 睡了 would only say he slept, not that he finally dropped off.

items.s: 这个月的钱已经花光了，下个月不能再买了。
items.s_py: zhè gè yuè de qián yǐ jīng huā guāng le xià gè yuè bù néng zài mǎi le
items.zh: 这个月的钱已经花光了，下个月不能再买了。
items.py: zhè gè yuè de qián yǐ jīng huā guāng le xià gè yuè bù néng zài mǎi le
items.en: This month's money is all spent, so no more buying next month.
items.why: Correct: 花光 means none is left, and 了 follows the pair. The second 了 belongs to the new clause and is independent.

items.src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào tā le
items.task: Say you did not find it.
items.zh: 我没找到它。
items.py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào tā
items.en: I didn't find it.
items.why: 没 goes before 找到 and replaces 了; 没找到它了 is not said.

items.s: 我的零花钱都花光完了。
items.s_py: wǒ de líng huā qián dōu huā guāng wán le
items.zh: 我的零花钱都花光了。
items.py: wǒ de líng huā qián dōu huā guāng le
items.en: All my pocket money is spent.
items.why: One verb takes one result: 花光 already means none is left. Adding 完 after 光 stacks two results, which Chinese does not do.

items.zh: 宝宝昨晚十点就睡着了。
items.py: bǎo bao zuó wǎn shí diǎn jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: The baby was already asleep by ten last night.
items.why: 睡着 is a verb plus result, with 了 after both. 睡了着 would insert 了 between them.

items.q: 你们吃___饭了吗？
items.zh: 你们吃完饭了吗？
items.py: nǐ men chī wán fàn le ma
items.en: Have you finished eating?
items.why: 吃完 asks whether eating has reached its end, and the object 饭 follows the pair. 会 and 懂 are about learning or understanding.

items.q: 他把新买的沙发摆___客厅中间。
items.zh: 他把新买的沙发摆在客厅中间。
items.py: tā bǎ xīn mǎi de shā fā bǎi zài kè tīng zhōng jiān
items.en: He put the new sofa in the middle of the living room.
items.why: 摆在 takes the place straight after it. 给 needs a person and 成 a new shape, and 摆走 would mean took it away.

items.s: 你做完作业没有了？
items.s_py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè méi yǒu le
items.zh: 你做完作业了没有？
items.py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you finished your homework?
items.why: In this question form 了 comes first and 没有 is the last word. 没有了 would mean 'no longer exist'.

items.q: 这种牛奶很难买，我跑了三家店才买___。
items.zh: 这种牛奶很难买，我跑了三家店才买到。
items.py: zhè zhǒng niú nǎi hěn nán mǎi wǒ pǎo le sān jiā diàn cái mǎi dào
items.en: This milk is hard to find; I went to three shops before I managed to get it.
items.why: 才买到 says the purchase succeeded only after three tries. 见 is only for perception verbs, and 懂 / 会 do not suit 买.

items.zh: 妈妈把三道菜都做好了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ sān dào cài dōu zuò hǎo le
items.en: Mum has all three dishes ready.
items.why: 做好 is a glued pair, and 把 plus 都 bring the dishes in front of it. 做三道菜好了 would break the pair.

items.q: 说明书写得太难了，爸爸看了三遍还是没看___。
items.zh: 说明书写得太难了，爸爸看了三遍还是没看懂。
items.py: shuō míng shū xiě de tài nán le bà ba kàn le sān biàn hái shi méi kàn dǒng
items.en: The instructions are so hard that Dad read them three times and still didn't understand.
items.why: 太难 and reading three times point to understanding, so 没看懂. 没看完 would mean he never reached the end, but he read it three times.

items.q: 哥哥把我的零食都吃___了，一点儿也没留。
items.zh: 哥哥把我的零食都吃光了，一点儿也没留。
items.py: gē ge bǎ wǒ de líng shí dōu chī guāng le yī diǎn r yě méi liú
items.en: My brother ate all my snacks and left none.
items.why: 一点儿也没留 means nothing is left, so 光. 吃走 is not said and 住 / 开 do not fit eating.

items.zh: 请把这张一百块换成零钱。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng yī bǎi kuài huàn chéng líng qián
items.en: Please change this hundred into small change.
items.why: 成 needs the new form 零钱 right behind it, so the note moves in front with 把. 换这张一百块成零钱 splits 换成.

items.q: 我找了半天，终于找___那件外套了。
items.zh: 我找了半天，终于找到那件外套了。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào nà jiàn wài tào le
items.en: I searched for ages and finally found that coat.
items.why: 'Found' is 找到: the search reached its target, matching 终于. 找完 would mean finished looking through things, and 懂 / 会 do not go with 找.

items.zh: 妈妈让我把密码记住。
items.py: mā ma ràng wǒ bǎ mì mǎ jì zhù
items.en: Mum told me to memorise the password.
items.why: 记住 is a glued pair, and 把 puts the password before it. 记密码住 would split the result from the verb.

items.s: 我吃完饭就去商店。
items.s_py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù shāng diàn
items.zh: 我吃完饭就去商店。
items.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù shāng diàn
items.en: I'll go to the shop as soon as I've eaten.
items.why: Correct: in 'after A, then B' 吃完 normally takes no 了, and 饭 follows the pair. Adding 了 is not needed.

items.q: 售货员把找的钱递___我，我数了数。
items.zh: 售货员把找的钱递给我，我数了数。
items.py: shòu huò yuán bǎ zhǎo de qián dì gěi wǒ wǒ shǔ le shǔ
items.en: The assistant handed me my change and I counted it.
items.why: 递给 puts the receiver 我 right after the verb. 在 needs a place, 成 a new form, and 递开 would mean pass apart.

items.zh: 朋友送给我一件礼物。
items.py: péng you sòng gěi wǒ yī jiàn lǐ wù
items.en: A friend gave me a present.
items.why: 送给 is glued, the receiver 我 comes right after it, and the gift follows. 送我给 reverses them.

items.q: 客人都到了，可是菜还___做好。
items.zh: 客人都到了，可是菜还没做好。
items.py: kè rén dōu dào le kě shì cài hái méi zuò hǎo
items.en: The guests have all arrived but the dishes aren't ready yet.
items.why: 还没 plus verb and result says it has not happened yet. 不 would turn it into a refusal or habit, and 别 is a command.

items.s: 你说什么？我没听见。
items.s_py: nǐ shuō shén me wǒ méi tīng jiàn
items.zh: 你说什么？我没听见。
items.py: nǐ shuō shén me wǒ méi tīng jiàn
items.en: What did you say? I didn't hear.
items.why: Correct: 没听见 is 'did not hear', with 没 before the pair and no 了. Learners wrongly add 了 or use 不.

items.q: 妈妈买了很多东西，我帮她把门打___。
items.zh: 妈妈买了很多东西，我帮她把门打开。
items.py: mā ma mǎi le hěn duō dōng xi wǒ bāng tā bǎ mén dǎ kāi
items.en: Mum bought a lot of things, so I opened the door for her.
items.why: 打开 means open, the sensible way to let her in with bags. 打住 means stop and 打走 means drive away.

items.q: 孩子们把房间打扫___了，妈妈夸了他们。
items.zh: 孩子们把房间打扫干净了，妈妈夸了他们。
items.py: hái zi men bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng le mā ma kuā le tā men
items.en: The children cleaned the room and Mum praised them.
items.why: Cleaning a room leaves it 干净, which is worth praising. 清楚 is for sight or sound and 对 means correct.

items.src_py: nǐ tīng dǒng le
items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
items.zh: 你听懂了吗？
items.py: nǐ tīng dǒng le ma
items.en: Did you understand?
items.why: 了吗 goes after the whole 听懂. 你不听懂吗 would ask about a different thing and does not suit a past event.

items.src: 我的书包放在椅子上了。
items.src_py: wǒ de shū bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng le
items.task: Say who did it: begin with 我 and use 把.
items.zh: 我把书包放在椅子上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ shū bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng le
items.en: I put my bag on the chair.
items.why: With the doer as subject, the bag goes in front with 把 and 放在 keeps the place right behind it.

items.q: 出门以前，我们要先把东西准备___。
items.zh: 出门以前，我们要先把东西准备好。
items.py: chū mén yǐ qián wǒ men yào xiān bǎ dōng xi zhǔn bèi hǎo
items.en: Before going out, we need to get everything ready first.
items.why: 准备好 means ready. 会 and 见 do not suit 准备, and 走 would mean prepared away.

items.zh: 我没找到那件毛衣。
items.py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào nà jiàn máo yī
items.en: I didn't find that sweater.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 找到 and there is no 了. 找没到 splits the verb and its result.

items.q: 价格牌上的字太小，我没看___价钱。
items.zh: 价格牌上的字太小，我没看清楚价钱。
items.py: jià gé pái shàng de zì tài xiǎo wǒ méi kàn qīng chu jià qián
items.en: The writing on the price tag was too small and I couldn't see the price clearly.
items.why: 字太小 means the sight was not clear, so 没看清楚. 干净 is for cleaning, and 看走 / 看掉 do not exist.

items.q: 昨天太吵了，我一晚上都没睡___。
items.zh: 昨天太吵了，我一晚上都没睡着。
items.py: zuó tiān tài chǎo le wǒ yī wǎn shang dōu méi shuì zháo
items.en: It was so noisy yesterday that I couldn't fall asleep all night.
items.why: 没睡着 means never managed to fall asleep. 睡到 needs a time or place, and 会 never follows 睡.

items.src_py: wǒ sòng tā yī fèn shēng rì lǐ wù
items.task: Rewrite with 把 and 送给.
items.zh: 我把生日礼物送给他了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ shēng rì lǐ wù sòng gěi tā le
items.en: I gave him the birthday present.
items.why: With 把 the gift goes in front, so 送给 takes the receiver 他 straight after it.

items.q: 他把一百块换___了零钱。
items.zh: 他把一百块换成了零钱。
items.py: tā bǎ yī bǎi kuài huàn chéng le líng qián
items.en: He changed the hundred yuan into small change.
items.why: 成 marks what the money turned into, here 零钱. 给 and 在 need a person or a place, and 换到 would not give 'into'.

items.s: 你有没有找到你昨天放在客厅里的书包？
items.s_py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhǎo dào nǐ zuó tiān fàng zài kè tīng lǐ de shū bāo
items.zh: 你有没有找到你昨天放在客厅里的书包？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhǎo dào nǐ zuó tiān fàng zài kè tīng lǐ de shū bāo
items.en: Did you find the bag you left in the living room yesterday?
items.why: Correct: 有没有 + verb + result is a common alternative to 了没有. The result 找到 stays glued with the object after it.

items.q: 收银员把钱数___了，一共是五十块，没有问题。
items.zh: 收银员把钱数对了，一共是五十块，没有问题。
items.py: shōu yín yuán bǎ qián shǔ duì le yī gòng shì wǔ shí kuài méi yǒu wèn tí
items.en: The cashier counted the money correctly: fifty yuan in all, no problem.
items.why: 没有问题 shows the count came out right, so 数对. 数错 would mean a mistake, and 光 / 走 are about money disappearing.

items.q: 妈妈把钥匙放___门口的桌子上了。
items.zh: 妈妈把钥匙放在门口的桌子上了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ yào shi fàng zài mén kǒu de zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: Mum put the keys on the table by the door.
items.why: 放在 is followed at once by the place where the keys end up. 给 needs a person and 成 needs a new form.

items.q: 商店里太吵了，我没听___店员说的价格。
items.zh: 商店里太吵了，我没听清楚店员说的价格。
items.py: shāng diàn lǐ tài chǎo le wǒ méi tīng qīng chu diàn yuán shuō de jià gé
items.en: The shop was so noisy that I didn't hear the price the assistant said clearly.
items.why: Noise is a hearing problem, so 听清楚. 听懂 would claim the words were not understood, and 干净 means clean.

items.s: 我们把旧沙发搬走了，换了一个新的。
items.s_py: wǒ men bǎ jiù shā fā bān zǒu le huàn le yī gè xīn de
items.zh: 我们把旧沙发搬走了，换了一个新的。
items.py: wǒ men bǎ jiù shā fā bān zǒu le huàn le yī gè xīn de
items.en: We carried the old sofa away and got a new one.
items.why: Correct: 搬走 means moved away from here, and 把 puts the sofa before it. 走 is the right result for taking something off.

items.s: 妈妈洗很干净了衣服。
items.s_py: mā ma xǐ hěn gān jìng le yī fu
items.zh: 妈妈洗干净了衣服。
items.py: mā ma xǐ gān jìng le yī fu
items.en: Mum washed the clothes clean.
items.why: The result 干净 attaches straight to 洗; 很 cannot be inserted. 洗得很干净 would be a different pattern with 得.

items.s: 你说得太快，我没听清楚了。
items.s_py: nǐ shuō de tài kuài wǒ méi tīng qīng chu le
items.zh: 你说得太快，我没听清楚。
items.py: nǐ shuō de tài kuài wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
items.en: You spoke too fast and I didn't hear clearly.
items.why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 is dropped. 没听清楚了 is not a normal sentence.

items.src: 孩子们把房间打扫干净了。
items.src_py: hái zi men bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng le
items.task: Make it negative.
items.zh: 孩子们没把房间打扫干净。
items.py: hái zi men méi bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng
items.en: The children didn't get the room cleaned.
items.why: 没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped. 把房间没打扫干净了 puts the negative in the wrong spot.

items.q: 你的新手机买___了没有？
items.zh: 你的新手机买到了没有？
items.py: nǐ de xīn shǒu jī mǎi dào le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you got your new phone yet?
items.why: The question asks whether the purchase succeeded, so 买到 plus 了没有. 买走, 买见 and 买懂 do not express getting something.

items.q: 妈妈用力把窗户推___，屋里一下子亮了。
items.zh: 妈妈用力把窗户推开，屋里一下子亮了。
items.py: mā ma yòng lì bǎ chuāng hu tuī kāi wū lǐ yī xià zi liàng le
items.en: Mum pushed the window open hard and the room suddenly brightened.
items.why: 推开 means push something open or apart, and the room getting light confirms it. 推住 means hold it still and 推走 means push it away.

items.src_py: nǎi nai shuì zháo le
items.task: Ask whether it has happened, with 没有.
items.zh: 奶奶睡着了没有？
items.py: nǎi nai shuì zháo le méi yǒu
items.en: Has Grandma fallen asleep yet?
items.why: The question form is verb + result + 了没有, with 没有 last. 睡没有着 would split the pair.

items.s: 店员找很错钱了。
items.s_py: diàn yuán zhǎo hěn cuò qián le
items.zh: 店员找错钱了。
items.py: diàn yuán zhǎo cuò qián le
items.en: The shop assistant gave the wrong change.
items.why: 错 is a result glued straight to the verb: 找错. 很 cannot be wedged in between, so 找很错 is not Chinese; the right form is 找错钱了.

items.zh: 你吃完了没有？
items.py: nǐ chī wán le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you finished eating?
items.why: The question ends in 了没有, with 了 after the whole 吃完 and 没有 as the last word. 吃了完 splits the result.

items.src_py: nǎi nai tīng jiàn le
items.task: Say she did not hear.
items.zh: 奶奶没听见。
items.py: nǎi nai méi tīng jiàn
items.en: Grandma didn't hear.
items.why: 没 before 听见 negates the result, and 了 disappears. 奶奶听见没了 is not Chinese.

items.q: 这封信太长，我只看了一半，还没看___。
items.zh: 这封信太长，我只看了一半，还没看完。
items.py: zhè fēng xìn tài cháng wǒ zhǐ kàn le yī bàn hái méi kàn wán
items.en: This letter is so long that I've only read half and haven't finished it.
items.why: 只看了一半 means the end has not been reached, so 没看完. 没看懂 would be about understanding and 没看见 about not seeing it.

items.q: 弟弟猜___了盒子里是什么，高兴得跳起来。
items.zh: 弟弟猜对了盒子里是什么，高兴得跳起来。
items.py: dì di cāi duì le hé zi lǐ shì shén me gāo xìng de tiào qǐ lái
items.en: My brother guessed right what was in the box and jumped for joy.
items.why: Jumping for joy fits a right guess, so 猜对. 猜错 would give no reason to be happy.

items.zh: 请你把这些旧衣服送给表妹。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè xiē jiù yī fu sòng gěi biǎo mèi
items.en: Please give these old clothes to my cousin.
items.why: 送给 takes the receiver right after it, and 把 puts the clothes in front of the verb. 送给 cannot be cut apart.

items.zh: 爸爸把价钱看错了。
items.py: bà ba bǎ jià qián kàn cuò le
items.en: Dad misread the price.
items.why: 错 comes right after the verb as 看错, and 了 follows the pair. 错看 copies English 'wrongly read' order and is not Chinese.

items.q: 爸爸把旧电视卖___了，换了一台新的。
items.zh: 爸爸把旧电视卖掉了，换了一台新的。
items.py: bà ba bǎ jiù diàn shì mài diào le huàn le yī tái xīn de
items.en: Dad sold off the old TV and got a new one.
items.why: 掉 means the old TV is gone for good. 光 would say every one was sold or nothing is left, which does not fit a single TV, and 开 / 住 do not describe selling.

items.q: 我去晚了，没买___那双鞋。
items.zh: 我去晚了，没买到那双鞋。
items.py: wǒ qù wǎn le méi mǎi dào nà shuāng xié
items.en: I got there too late and didn't get those shoes.
items.why: 买 only attempts a purchase; 买到 means it succeeded. 见 works only with perception verbs like 看 and 听, and 会 / 懂 are about learning or understanding.

items.q: 我买到___两张电影票，一起去吧。
items.zh: 我买到了两张电影票，一起去吧。
items.py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng diàn yǐng piào yī qǐ qù ba
items.en: I got two film tickets, let's go together.
items.why: 了 follows the result 到 and comes before the counted object. 买到过 would mean once got, which does not suggest going together now.

items.zh: 弟弟没看见我。
items.py: dì di méi kàn jiàn wǒ
items.en: My brother didn't see me.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 看见, with no 了. 看没见 and 没见看 break the glued pair.

items.q: 我把价钱算___了，多给了他十块。
items.zh: 我把价钱算错了，多给了他十块。
items.py: wǒ bǎ jià qián suàn cuò le duō gěi le tā shí kuài
items.en: I worked out the price wrongly and gave him ten yuan too much.
items.why: 多给了十块 shows the sum went wrong, so 算错. 算对 would mean no overpayment, and 算完 says nothing about being wrong.

items.src_py: tā rēng diào le jiù xié
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 他把旧鞋扔掉了。
items.py: tā bǎ jiù xié rēng diào le
items.en: He threw away the old shoes.
items.why: 把 moves the shoes in front of 扔掉, and 了 goes at the end.

items.q: 我把新买的鞋放___鞋柜里了。
items.zh: 我把新买的鞋放在鞋柜里了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ xīn mǎi de xié fàng zài xié guì lǐ le
items.en: I put the new shoes in the shoe cabinet.
items.why: 放在 plus a place says where the shoes ended up. 给 and 成 need a person or a new form, and 放走 would mean let go.

items.q: 这个月的零花钱我都花___了，只好向妈妈借。
items.zh: 这个月的零花钱我都花光了，只好向妈妈借。
items.py: zhè gè yuè de líng huā qián wǒ dōu huā guāng le zhǐ hǎo xiàng mā ma jiè
items.en: I've spent all my pocket money this month, so I have to borrow from Mum.
items.why: 光 means none is left, which is why borrowing is the only option. 花住 and 花开 describe nothing here, and 会 is for learned skills.

items.src_py: wǒ chī wán le
items.task: Say it has not happened yet.
items.zh: 我还没吃完。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī wán
items.en: I haven't finished eating yet.
items.why: 还没 plus verb and result means not yet, and 了 is dropped. 还没吃完了 is wrong.

items.q: 请把妈妈的电话号码记___，别忘了。
items.zh: 请把妈妈的电话号码记住，别忘了。
items.py: qǐng bǎ mā ma de diàn huà hào mǎ jì zhù bié wàng le
items.en: Please remember Mum's phone number and don't forget it.
items.why: 记住 means fix it in memory, matching 别忘了. 记掉 would mean get rid of, and 开 / 走 do not combine with 记.

items.q: 妈妈把碗洗___了，可以用了。
items.zh: 妈妈把碗洗干净了，可以用了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ wǎn xǐ gān jìng le kě yǐ yòng le
items.en: Mum washed the bowls clean, so they can be used.
items.why: Washing leaves things 干净 (clean), which is why they can be used. 清楚 is for sight or sound and 对 means right or correct.

items.s: 我写了完作业。
items.s_py: wǒ xiě le wán zuò yè
items.zh: 我写完作业了。
items.py: wǒ xiě wán zuò yè le
items.en: I've finished my homework.
items.why: 了 never sits between the verb and its result. It goes after 完 or at the end of the sentence.

items.zh: 我们吃完饭就去商店。
items.py: wǒ men chī wán fàn jiù qù shāng diàn
items.en: We'll go to the shop as soon as we've eaten.
items.why: 吃完 is one unit with the object 饭 after it, and an 'after A, then B' sentence takes no 了. 吃饭完 splits the unit.

items.q: 奶奶把钱包交___了妈妈。
items.zh: 奶奶把钱包交给了妈妈。
items.py: nǎi nai bǎ qián bāo jiāo gěi le mā ma
items.en: Grandma handed the purse to Mum.
items.why: 交给 is 'hand over to', with the receiver 妈妈 right after. 成 and 在 do not take a person, and 走 would mean taken away.

items.q: 这件衣服太旧了，妈妈让我把它扔___。
items.zh: 这件衣服太旧了，妈妈让我把它扔掉。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu tài jiù le mā ma ràng wǒ bǎ tā rēng diào
items.en: This piece of clothing is too old, so Mum told me to throw it away.
items.why: 扔掉 means get rid of. 扔走 is not said, and 扔着 and 扔会 are not words.

items.q: 医生开的药我已经吃___了，咳嗽也好多了。
items.zh: 医生开的药我已经吃完了，咳嗽也好多了。
items.py: yī shēng kāi de yào wǒ yǐ jīng chī wán le ké sou yě hǎo duō le
items.en: I've already finished the medicine the doctor prescribed, and my cough is much better.
items.why: 吃完 says the course of medicine reached its end. 会 is for a skill you have learned, and 见 and 住 do not combine with 吃 to mean finished.

items.q: 天气预报说明天下雪，我们的厚衣服都准备___了。
items.zh: 天气预报说明天下雪，我们的厚衣服都准备好了。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān xià xuě wǒ men de hòu yī fu dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le
items.en: The forecast says it will snow tomorrow, and our warm clothes are all ready.
items.why: 准备 normally takes 好 for ready and set. 懂 and 会 are about understanding and skills, and 到 would only mean reaching a goal, not being ready.

items.q: 我终于学___游泳了，夏天可以自己去海边玩了。
items.zh: 我终于学会游泳了，夏天可以自己去海边玩了。
items.py: wǒ zhōng yú xué huì yóu yǒng le xià tiān kě yǐ zì jǐ qù hǎi biān wán le
items.en: I've finally learned to swim, so this summer I can go to the beach by myself.
items.why: 学会 means you studied until you can do it, which is what lets you go alone. 见 and 住 do not mean learning, and 懂 is only understanding.

items.q: 医生让你吃___饭再吃这种药。
items.zh: 医生让你吃完饭再吃这种药。
items.py: yī shēng ràng nǐ chī wán fàn zài chī zhè zhǒng yào
items.en: The doctor says to take this medicine after you've finished eating.
items.why: 吃饭 is a verb-object word, so the result goes right after 吃: 吃完饭 means the meal has ended. 到, 见 and 懂 cannot say a meal is finished.

items.q: 医生说他腿上的伤还没长___，所以暂时不能去滑冰。
items.zh: 医生说他腿上的伤还没长好，所以暂时不能去滑冰。
items.py: yī shēng shuō tā tuǐ shàng de shāng hái méi zhǎng hǎo suǒ yǐ zàn shí bù néng qù huá bīng
items.en: The doctor says the wound on his leg hasn't healed properly yet, so he can't go skating for now.
items.why: 长好 (zhǎng hǎo) says the wound has healed properly and is usable again. 完 would say growth reached its end, and 会 and 懂 are about skills and understanding.

items.q: 夏天太热了，我跑了三家店才买___风扇。
items.zh: 夏天太热了，我跑了三家店才买到风扇。
items.py: xià tiān tài rè le wǒ pǎo le sān jiā diàn cái mǎi dào fēng shàn
items.en: It was so hot that summer I went to three shops before I managed to buy a fan.
items.why: 买到 says the buying succeeded and you got the item. 见 only goes with seeing and hearing, and 懂 and 会 are about understanding and skills.

items.q: 我找了半天，终于在包里找___体温计了。
items.zh: 我找了半天，终于在包里找到体温计了。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zài bāo lǐ zhǎo dào tǐ wēn jì le
items.en: I searched for ages and finally found the thermometer in my bag.
items.why: 找到 says the search reached its target. 找完 would only say you finished looking, and 懂 and 会 do not fit the verb 找.

items.q: 医生用了很多英文词，我一个也没听___。
items.zh: 医生用了很多英文词，我一个也没听懂。
items.py: yī shēng yòng le hěn duō yīng wén cí wǒ yī gè yě méi tīng dǒng
items.en: The doctor used lots of English words and I didn't understand a single one.
items.why: 懂 is the result for understanding what you hear. 见 and 到 only say the sound reached your ears, which the cue does not ask for, and 完 is about finishing.

items.q: 你昨天寄的体检报告，我今天上午已经收___了。
items.zh: 你昨天寄的体检报告，我今天上午已经收到了。
items.py: nǐ zuó tiān jì de tǐ jiǎn bào gào wǒ jīn tiān shàng wǔ yǐ jīng shōu dào le
items.en: I already received the medical report you sent yesterday this morning.
items.why: 收到 says the report reached you. 见 is limited to seeing and hearing and cannot follow 收, and 懂 and 会 would mean understanding and skill.

items.q: 他说得太快，虽然每个字我都听见了，但整句话没听___。
items.zh: 他说得太快，虽然每个字我都听见了，但整句话没听懂。
items.py: tā shuō de tài kuài suī rán měi gè zì wǒ dōu tīng jiàn le dàn zhěng jù huà méi tīng dǒng
items.en: He spoke so fast that although I heard every word, I didn't understand the whole sentence.
items.why: 但 sets up a contrast: every word was heard (听见) but the sentence was not understood (听懂). 到 and 见 would repeat heard, and 完 is about finishing.

items.q: 天气预报是中文的，我看了三遍还是没看___。
items.zh: 天气预报是中文的，我看了三遍还是没看懂。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shì zhōng wén de wǒ kàn le sān biàn hái shi méi kàn dǒng
items.en: The weather forecast was in Chinese; I read it three times and still didn't understand it.
items.why: 看懂 is understanding what you read. 见 and 到 would mean you did not see it at all, which three readings contradict, and 完 would mean not finished.

items.q: 护士把我的名字写___了，应该是李，不是力。
items.zh: 护士把我的名字写错了，应该是李，不是力。
items.py: hù shi bǎ wǒ de míng zi xiě cuò le yīng gāi shì lǐ bú shì lì
items.en: The nurse wrote my name wrongly; it should be 李, not 力.
items.why: 错 right after 写 says the writing came out wrong, and the second half gives the correction. 对 would say it was written correctly, which contradicts 应该是…不是….

items.q: 旁边太吵了，医生的话我一个字也没听___，请他再说一遍。
items.zh: 旁边太吵了，医生的话我一个字也没听清楚，请他再说一遍。
items.py: páng biān tài chǎo le yī shēng de huà wǒ yī gè zì yě méi tīng qīng chu qǐng tā zài shuō yī biàn
items.en: It was so noisy next to me that I could not hear a word the doctor said clearly, so I asked him to say it again.
items.why: 听清楚 is the result for hearing distinctly, which noise ruins. 干净 means clean and 错 would mean misheard, and 完 would mean you did not reach the end.

items.q: 雪天路很脏，我把鞋擦___再进屋。
items.zh: 雪天路很脏，我把鞋擦干净再进屋。
items.py: xuě tiān lù hěn zāng wǒ bǎ xié cā gān jìng zài jìn wū
items.en: The road was dirty in the snow, so I wiped my shoes clean before going in.
items.why: 擦干净 says the wiping left the shoes clean, which suits dirty roads. 对 and 错 are about right and wrong, and 清楚 is for hearing and seeing clearly.

items.q: 你把吃药的次数记___了，应该是一天两次，不是三次。
items.zh: 你把吃药的次数记错了，应该是一天两次，不是三次。
items.py: nǐ bǎ chī yào de cì shù jì cuò le yīng gāi shì yī tiān liǎng cì bú shì sān cì
items.en: You got the number of doses wrong; it should be twice a day, not three times.
items.why: 记错 means remembered it wrongly, and the correction after 应该是 shows that. 记住 would mean successfully kept in mind, which the correction contradicts.

items.q: 他把体检表上的数字抄___了一个，结果医生也算错了。
items.zh: 他把体检表上的数字抄错了一个，结果医生也算错了。
items.py: tā bǎ tǐ jiǎn biǎo shàng de shù zì chāo cuò le yī gè jié guǒ yī shēng yě suàn cuò le
items.en: He copied one of the numbers on the medical form wrongly, so the doctor's calculation came out wrong too.
items.why: 抄错 says one number was copied wrongly, which explains why the calculation is wrong. 抄对 would say it was copied correctly, and 清楚 and 干净 do not describe a wrong number.

items.q: 这个电话号码很重要，请你一定要记___。
items.zh: 这个电话号码很重要，请你一定要记住。
items.py: zhè ge diàn huà hào mǎ hěn zhòng yào qǐng nǐ yí dìng yào jì zhù
items.en: This phone number is important, so please be sure to remember it.
items.why: 记住 means fix it in your memory so it stays. A bare 记 only says write down or note, 开 means open or apart, and 掉 and 走 mean gone and taken away.

items.q: 昨天太热了，我一晚上都没睡___。
items.zh: 昨天太热了，我一晚上都没睡着。
items.py: zuó tiān tài rè le wǒ yī wǎn shàng dōu méi shuì zháo
items.en: It was so hot yesterday that I couldn't fall asleep all night.
items.why: 睡着 (zháo) is the result for actually falling asleep, here negated with 没. 睡住 and 睡掉 do not exist, and 光 would mean no sleep was left.

items.q: 夏天太热了，请把窗户打___。
items.zh: 夏天太热了，请把窗户打开。
items.py: xià tiān tài rè le qǐng bǎ chuāng hu dǎ kāi
items.en: It's so hot in summer, please open the window.
items.why: 打开 means make something open, which is what you do to a window. 住 means held or stopped, 掉 means got rid of, and 光 means nothing left.

items.q: 感冒好了，这些没吃完的药可以扔___了。
items.zh: 感冒好了，这些没吃完的药可以扔掉了。
items.py: gǎn mào hǎo le zhè xiē méi chī wán de yào kě yǐ rēng diào le
items.en: Your cold is better, so you can throw away the medicine you didn't finish.
items.why: 扔掉 means throw away and get rid of. 走 means taken away by someone, 住 means held in place, and 开 means open or apart.

items.q: 有人把我放在门口的雨伞拿___了。
items.zh: 有人把我放在门口的雨伞拿走了。
items.py: yǒu rén bǎ wǒ fàng zài mén kǒu de yǔ sǎn ná zǒu le
items.en: Somebody took away the umbrella I left by the door.
items.why: 拿走 says someone took the thing away with them. 拿住 means hold on to it, and 光 would mean the umbrellas are used up.

items.q: 夏天我们太爱喝冰水了，一大壶冰水一下子就喝___了。
items.zh: 夏天我们太爱喝冰水了，一大壶冰水一下子就喝光了。
items.py: xià tiān wǒ men tài ài hē bīng shuǐ le yī dà hú bīng shuǐ yī xià zi jiù hē guāng le
items.en: We love iced water so much in summer that the whole jug was gone in no time.
items.why: 喝光 stresses that nothing is left in the jug. 住, 开 and 着 do not say the water is used up.

items.q: 他一路上都在咳嗽，同事让他吃片药压___，免得开会时影响大家。
items.zh: 他一路上都在咳嗽，同事让他吃片药压住，免得开会时影响大家。
items.py: tā yī lù shàng dōu zài ké sou tóng shì ràng tā chī piàn yào yā zhù miǎn de kāi huì shí yǐng xiǎng dà jiā
items.en: He coughed all the way, so his colleagues told him to take a pill to suppress it so that he wouldn't disturb everyone in the meeting.
items.why: 压住 means hold down and keep under control, which fits suppressing a cough. 压掉 and 压光 do not exist, and 压开 would mean pressing something open.

items.q: 跑步的时候他突然头晕，赶紧扶___旁边的树。
items.zh: 跑步的时候他突然头晕，赶紧扶住旁边的树。
items.py: pǎo bù de shí hòu tā tū rán tóu yūn gǎn jǐn fú zhù páng biān de shù
items.en: While running he suddenly felt dizzy and quickly grabbed hold of the tree beside him.
items.why: 扶住 means hold on to something so you stay steady. 走 means taken away, 掉 means got rid of, and 光 means none left.

items.q: 春天来了，天气暖和了，大家都把厚衣服脱___了。
items.zh: 春天来了，天气暖和了，大家都把厚衣服脱掉了。
