items.py: chūn tiān lái le tiān qì nuǎn huo le dà jiā dōu bǎ hòu yī fu tuō diào le
items.en: Spring has come and it's warm, so everybody has taken off their heavy clothes.
items.why: 脱掉 means take off and be rid of. 住 and 着 do not describe removing clothes, and 走 would mean the clothes were carried away.

items.q: 太阳出来了，雾慢慢散___了。
items.zh: 太阳出来了，雾慢慢散开了。
items.py: tài yáng chū lái le wù màn màn sàn kāi le
items.en: The sun came out and the fog slowly cleared.
items.why: 散开 means spread apart and break up, which is what fog does. 住 would mean held in place, which is the opposite, and 着 and 走 do not fit 散.

items.q: 我把雨伞放___门后面了。
items.zh: 我把雨伞放在门后面了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ yǔ sǎn fàng zài mén hòu miàn le
items.en: I put the umbrella behind the door.
items.why: 放在 needs the place right after it: 放在门后面. 给 would need a person, 成 a new form, and 着 is not a result that takes a place.

items.q: 妈妈把感冒药递___我，让我快点吃。
items.zh: 妈妈把感冒药递给我，让我快点吃。
items.py: mā ma bǎ gǎn mào yào dì gěi wǒ ràng wǒ kuài diǎn chī
items.en: Mum handed me the cold medicine and told me to take it quickly.
items.why: 递给 hands something over to a person, and the receiver 我 follows. 在 needs a place, 成 needs a new form, and 住 would mean held in place.

items.q: 医生把这张药方写___了中文，我才看得懂。
items.zh: 医生把这张药方写成了中文，我才看得懂。
items.py: yī shēng bǎ zhè zhāng yào fāng xiě chéng le zhōng wén wǒ cái kàn de dǒng
items.en: The doctor wrote the prescription in Chinese, so I could read it.
items.why: 写成了中文 says the prescription ended up in Chinese form. 给 would need a person, 在 would need a place after it, and 走 does not fit.

items.q: 冬天的雪很厚，孩子们把雪堆___了一座小山。
items.zh: 冬天的雪很厚，孩子们把雪堆成了一座小山。
items.py: dōng tiān de xuě hěn hòu hái zi men bǎ xuě duī chéng le yī zuò xiǎo shān
items.en: The winter snow was thick, and the children piled it up into a small hill.
items.why: 堆成 says the snow turned into a new shape, a small hill. 给 would need a person, and 在 and 到 would need a place, not a result form.

items.q: 请你把今天的天气预报转告___每一位同学，明天可能有大雨。
items.zh: 请你把今天的天气预报转告给每一位同学，明天可能有大雨。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ jīn tiān de tiān qì yù bào zhuǎn gào gěi měi yī wèi tóng xué míng tiān kě néng yǒu dà yǔ
items.en: Please pass today's weather forecast on to every student; there may be heavy rain tomorrow.
items.why: 转告给 passes information to a person, with the receivers 每一位同学 right after it. 在 needs a place and 成 needs a new form.

items.q: 他把每次的检查结果都登记___一个小本子上，方便下次看病。
items.zh: 他把每次的检查结果都登记在一个小本子上，方便下次看病。
items.py: tā bǎ měi cì de jiǎn chá jié guǒ dōu dēng jì zài yī gè xiǎo běn zi shàng fāng biàn xià cì kàn bìng
items.en: He records every set of test results in a little notebook so it is handy for his next doctor visit.
items.why: 登记在…上 puts the record on a place, the notebook. 给 would need a person, 成 would need a new form, and 住 would mean held in place.

items.q: 夏天太热，爸爸把西瓜切___八块，大家一起吃。
items.zh: 夏天太热，爸爸把西瓜切成八块，大家一起吃。
items.py: xià tiān tài rè bà ba bǎ xī gua qiè chéng bā kuài dà jiā yì qǐ chī
items.en: It was so hot in summer that Dad cut the watermelon into eight pieces for everyone to share.
items.why: 切成八块 says the watermelon turned into eight pieces. 给 would need a person and 在 would need a place after it.

items.q: 医生让他把这些药分___三次吃。
items.zh: 医生让他把这些药分成三次吃。
items.py: yī shēng ràng tā bǎ zhè xiē yào fēn chéng sān cì chī
items.en: The doctor told him to split this medicine into three doses.
items.why: 分成三次 divides the medicine into three portions. 给 would need a receiver, and 在 and 到 would need a place, not a number of portions.

items.q: 昨天雾太大了，我们都___看见山。
items.zh: 昨天雾太大了，我们都没看见山。
items.py: zuó tiān wù tài dà le wǒ men dōu méi kàn jiàn shān
items.en: It was so foggy yesterday that none of us saw the mountain.
items.why: 昨天 marks one past occasion, so the result 看见 is negated with 没. 不 would be a refusal or a habit, 别 is a command, and 会 is not a negative.

items.q: 今天的天气预报我___看完，不知道明天下不下雨。
items.zh: 今天的天气预报我还没看完，不知道明天下不下雨。
items.py: jīn tiān de tiān qì yù bào wǒ hái méi kàn wán bù zhī dào míng tiān xià bù xià yǔ
items.en: I haven't finished the weather forecast yet, so I don't know whether it will rain tomorrow.
items.why: 还没 says the result has not come about yet, and the sentence continues from that. 不看完 would be a refusal to finish, which does not fit the cue.

items.q: 他昨天___听清楚医生的话，所以今天又去了一次医院。
items.zh: 他昨天没听清楚医生的话，所以今天又去了一次医院。
items.py: tā zuó tiān méi tīng qīng chu yī shēng de huà suǒ yǐ jīn tiān yòu qù le yī cì yī yuàn
items.en: He didn't hear the doctor clearly yesterday, so he went to the hospital again today.
items.why: 昨天 makes it a past event, so 没 negates the result 听清楚 and there is no 了. 不听清楚 would be a refusal or a general habit.

items.q: 对不起，我___找到你的体检报告，明天再给你好吗？
items.zh: 对不起，我没找到你的体检报告，明天再给你好吗？
items.py: duì bù qǐ wǒ méi zhǎo dào nǐ de tǐ jiǎn bào gào míng tiān zài gěi nǐ hǎo ma
items.en: Sorry, I didn't find your medical report; may I give it to you tomorrow?
items.why: 没 negates 找到 because the search ended without a result. 不找到 is not a way to say could not find, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 虽然已经吃了三天药，但是他的药还___吃完，医生让他继续吃。
items.zh: 虽然已经吃了三天药，但是他的药还没吃完，医生让他继续吃。
items.py: suī rán yǐ jīng chī le sān tiān yào dàn shì tā de yào hái méi chī wán yī shēng ràng tā jì xù chī
items.en: Although he has taken the medicine for three days, he hasn't finished the course yet, and the doctor told him to keep taking it.
items.why: 还没吃完 says the course has not been finished yet. 还不吃完 is not natural, because with 还 the negation of a result that has not come about is 没.

items.q: 夏天的雨太大，我的伞___撑住，被风吹走了。
items.zh: 夏天的雨太大，我的伞没撑住，被风吹走了。
items.py: xià tiān de yǔ tài dà wǒ de sǎn méi chēng zhù bèi fēng chuī zǒu le
items.en: The summer rain was so heavy that my umbrella couldn't hold up and was blown away by the wind.
items.why: 伞没撑住 says that the holding result did not happen, and the next clause tells what followed. 不撑住 would be a refusal, which an umbrella cannot do.

items.q: 我洗___澡就去睡觉了。
items.zh: 我洗完澡就去睡觉了。
items.py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù qù shuì jiào le
items.en: I went to bed as soon as I'd had my shower.
items.why: 洗澡 is a verb-object word, so the result goes right after the verb part: 洗完澡. 洗着澡 would mean in the middle of it, and 会 and 到 do not fit.

items.q: 下___课，我们一起去医院看小王吧。
items.zh: 下完课，我们一起去医院看小王吧。
items.py: xià wán kè wǒ men yì qǐ qù yī yuàn kàn xiǎo wáng ba
items.en: Let's go to the hospital to visit Xiao Wang together after class finishes.
items.why: 下课 is a verb-object word and the result sits after 下: 下完课 means class has ended. 着 would mean class is still going on, and 会 and 见 do not fit.

items.q: 我刚才在抽屉里找到___两个体温计。
items.zh: 我刚才在抽屉里找到了两个体温计。
items.py: wǒ gāng cái zài chōu ti lǐ zhǎo dào le liǎng gè tǐ wēn jì
items.en: I just found two thermometers in the drawer.
items.why: 了 goes right after the result 找到 before a counted object. 过 would say you once found them, which 刚才 rules out, and 着 and 的 do not fit.

items.q: 我吃完___两片药，才觉得舒服一点。
items.zh: 我吃完了两片药，才觉得舒服一点。
items.py: wǒ chī wán le liǎng piàn yào cái jué de shū fu yì diǎn
items.en: I only felt a bit better after I'd taken the two tablets.
items.why: 了 follows the result 吃完 before the counted object 两片药. 着 and 的 do not fit a completed action, and 过 would say you had once done it.

items.q: 天气太热，他一口气喝完___整整一瓶冰水，结果肚子疼了。
items.zh: 天气太热，他一口气喝完了整整一瓶冰水，结果肚子疼了。
items.py: tiān qì tài rè tā yì kǒu qì hē wán le zhěng zhěng yī píng bīng shuǐ jié guǒ dǔ zi téng le
items.en: It was so hot that he drank a whole bottle of iced water in one go, and then his stomach hurt.
items.why: 了 goes after the result 喝完 and before the counted object. 着 and 的 do not fit a completed action, and 过 would turn it into past experience.

items.q: 风太大，晾在外面的衣服都被吹走___。
items.zh: 风太大，晾在外面的衣服都被吹走了。
items.py: fēng tài dà liàng zài wài miàn de yī fu dōu bèi chuī zǒu le
items.en: The wind was so strong that the clothes hanging outside were all blown away.
items.why: 了 closes the sentence after the result 吹走 and shows the change has happened. 着 and 的 do not end a completed event, and 过 would be about past experience.

items.q: 你的感冒药吃完___没有？
items.zh: 你的感冒药吃完了没有？
items.py: nǐ de gǎn mào yào chī wán le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you finished your cold medicine?
items.why: The question form is verb + result + 了 + 没有, so 了 comes before 没有. 着, 过 and 的 do not ask whether a result has come about.

items.q: —你看完今天的天气预报了吗？—看完___。
items.zh: —你看完今天的天气预报了吗？—看完了。
items.py: nǐ kàn wán jīn tiān de tiān qì yù bào le ma kàn wán le
items.en: —Have you finished reading today's weather forecast? —Yes, I've finished.
items.why: A yes answer repeats verb + result + 了: 看完了. 吗 is only for the question, and 没 and 不 would make the answer negative.

items.q: —你把药吃完了吗？—___吃完，我晚上再吃。
items.zh: —你把药吃完了吗？—还没吃完，我晚上再吃。
items.py: nǐ bǎ yào chī wán le ma hái méi chī wán wǒ wǎn shàng zài chī
items.en: —Have you finished the medicine? —Not yet, I'll take it again this evening.
items.why: 还没吃完 is the standard answer for not yet. 不吃完 would be refusing to finish, 别 is a command, and 都 does not negate.

items.q: 你要的感冒药买到了___？
items.zh: 你要的感冒药买到了没有？
items.py: nǐ yào de gǎn mào yào mǎi dào le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you managed to buy the cold medicine you wanted?
items.why: The 了没有 question puts 了 after the result and ends on 没有. 没有了 reverses the order, and 不有 and 吗没有 do not exist.

items.zh: 我洗完澡就睡觉了。
items.py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào le
items.en: I went to bed as soon as I'd had a shower.
items.why: 洗澡 is a verb-object word, so the result 完 attaches to 洗 and the object 澡 follows: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is wrong.

items.zh: 妈妈把姜汤煮好了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ jiāng tāng zhǔ hǎo le
items.en: Mum has got the ginger soup ready.
items.why: With 把 the thing moves in front of the verb, and 煮好 stays together with 了 after it. 了 cannot come between 煮 and 好.

items.zh: 今天的体检报告医生还没看完。
items.py: jīn tiān de tǐ jiǎn bào gào yī shēng hái méi kàn wán
items.en: The doctor hasn't finished reading today's medical report yet.
items.why: The report can be fronted as a topic or follow 看完, and 还没 sits before the whole 看完 with no 了. The object never stands between 看 and 完.

items.zh: 我找到了两个体温计。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo dào le liǎng gè tǐ wēn jì
items.en: I found two thermometers.
items.why: 了 follows the result 找到 and never the bare verb 找; 找了到 is wrong. With a counted object 了 right after 找到 is the usual place.

items.zh: 我把药放在桌子上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: I put the medicine on the table.
items.why: 放在桌子上 needs its place right after 放在, so the medicine moves in front with 把. 了 closes the sentence.

items.zh: 医生把药方交给了护士。
items.py: yī shēng bǎ yào fāng jiāo gěi le hù shi
items.en: The doctor handed the prescription to the nurse.
items.why: 交给 must be followed at once by the receiver 护士, so the prescription goes after 把. 了 can follow 给 or end the sentence.

items.zh: 请把这份天气预报翻译成英文。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zhè fèn tiān qì yù bào fān yì chéng yīng wén
items.en: Please translate this weather forecast into English.
items.why: 翻译成 needs the new form 英文 straight after it, so the forecast moves in front with 把. 翻译这份天气预报成英文 is wrong.

items.zh: 他把外套借给了没带伞的同学。
items.py: tā bǎ wài tào jiè gěi le méi dài sǎn de tóng xué
items.en: He lent his coat to a classmate who had no umbrella.
items.why: 借给 must be followed at once by the receiver, here 没带伞的同学. The coat goes after 把, and 了 follows 给 or ends the sentence.

items.zh: 我昨天没睡好。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān méi shuì hǎo
items.en: I didn't sleep well yesterday.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 睡好 and no 了 is added. 睡没好 would split the verb from its result.

items.zh: 雾太大了，我没看清楚路。
items.py: wù tài dà le wǒ méi kàn qīng chu lù
items.en: The fog was so thick that I couldn't see the road clearly.
items.why: 没 goes before 看清楚 as a whole and the object 路 comes after it. 看没清楚 and 看清楚了路没 are not possible.

items.zh: 今年冬天我们还没看见雪。
items.py: jīn nián dōng tiān wǒ men hái méi kàn jiàn xuě
items.en: We haven't seen any snow yet this winter.
items.why: 还没 goes before the whole 看见 and drops 了. The time word 今年冬天 comes before the verb phrase, either before or after 我们.

items.zh: 我在药店买到了三盒感冒药。
items.py: wǒ zài yào diàn mǎi dào le sān hé gǎn mào yào
items.en: I managed to buy three boxes of cold medicine at the pharmacy.
items.why: 了 goes right after the result 买到, before the counted object. 买了到 is wrong.

items.zh: 你看见雪了吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn jiàn xuě le ma
items.en: Have you seen the snow?
items.why: The yes-no question is verb + result + 了 + 吗. The object can also be fronted as a topic, but 了 never goes inside 看见.

items.zh: 你把药吃完了没有？
items.py: nǐ bǎ yào chī wán le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you finished the medicine?
items.why: 把 puts the medicine before the verb, and the question ends in 了没有 after the whole 吃完. 没有了 reverses the order.

items.zh: 昨晚下雪的时候你睡着了没有？
items.py: zuó wǎn xià xuě de shí hòu nǐ shuì zháo le méi yǒu
items.en: Had you fallen asleep when it snowed last night?
items.why: 睡着 stays together and 了没有 closes the question. The time clause can come before or after 你, but not after 睡着.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le yī shēng de huà
items.task: Say you did NOT understand.
items.zh: 我没听懂医生的话。
items.py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng yī shēng de huà
items.en: I didn't understand what the doctor said.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 听懂 and 了 disappears. 不听懂 is not a past negative, and the fronted object order is also correct.

items.src_py: tā shuì zháo le
items.task: Say he did NOT fall asleep.
items.zh: 他没睡着。
items.py: tā méi shuì zháo
items.en: He didn't fall asleep.
items.why: 没 goes before 睡着 as a whole and 了 is dropped. 睡没着 would split the verb from its result.

items.src_py: wǒ hē wán le nà bēi jiāng tāng
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 我把那杯姜汤喝完了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà bēi jiāng tāng hē wán le
items.en: I finished that cup of ginger soup.
items.why: 把 moves the specific object in front of the verb, and 喝完 keeps 完 with 了 after it.

items.src_py: wǒ sòng le nà bǎ sǎn gěi tā
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 我把那把伞送给他了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà bǎ sǎn sòng gěi tā le
items.en: I gave him that umbrella.
items.why: 把 moves the umbrella in front, so 送给 can be followed at once by the receiver 他. 了 goes at the end.

items.src: 孩子们把雪堆成一个大雪人。
items.src_py: hái zi men bǎ xuě duī chéng yī gè dà xuě rén
items.task: Say it has been done: add 了.
items.zh: 孩子们把雪堆成了一个大雪人。
items.py: hái zi men bǎ xuě duī chéng le yī gè dà xuě rén
items.en: The children piled the snow into a big snowman.
items.why: 了 goes right after 成 or at the end of the sentence, never between 堆 and 成. 堆了成 is wrong.

items.src_py: tā mǎi dào yào le
items.task: Say he bought three boxes of medicine.
items.zh: 他买到了三盒药。
items.py: tā mǎi dào le sān hé yào
items.en: He managed to buy three boxes of medicine.
items.why: 了 goes right after the result 买到 when a counted object follows. 买了到 is wrong.

items.src_py: nǐ kàn wán tiān qì yù bào le
items.task: Turn it into a yes-no question with 吗.
items.zh: 你看完天气预报了吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn wán tiān qì yù bào le ma
items.en: Have you finished the weather forecast?
items.why: Add 吗 at the end of verb + result + object + 了. The fronted object order is also fine.

items.src_py: tā zhǎo dào tǐ wēn jì le
items.task: Ask with 了没有.
items.zh: 他找到体温计了没有？
items.py: tā zhǎo dào tǐ wēn jì le méi yǒu
items.en: Has he found the thermometer?
items.why: The question form is verb + result + object + 了没有, with 没有 as the last word. The fronted object order is also correct.

items.src_py: wǒ chī wán yào le
items.task: Say you have NOT yet.
items.zh: 我还没吃完药。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī wán yào
items.en: I haven't finished taking the medicine yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 吃完 and 了 drops out. The medicine can also be fronted as the topic.

items.src: 医生听清楚了我的问题。
items.src_py: yī shēng tīng qīng chu le wǒ de wèn tí
items.task: Say the doctor did NOT.
items.zh: 医生没听清楚我的问题。
items.py: yī shēng méi tīng qīng chu wǒ de wèn tí
items.en: The doctor didn't hear my question clearly.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 听清楚 and 了 disappears. 听没清楚 would split the verb from its result.

items.src_py: tā chī wán le yī shēng kāi de yào
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 他把医生开的药吃完了。
items.py: tā bǎ yī shēng kāi de yào chī wán le
items.en: He finished the medicine the doctor prescribed.
items.why: 把 moves the long specific object in front of the verb, and 吃完 keeps 完 with 了 after it.

items.src_py: wǒ tīng qīng chu le tā de huà
items.task: Say you heard it WRONG (use 错).
items.zh: 我听错了他的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng cuò le tā de huà
items.en: I misheard what he said.
items.why: 错 attaches right after 听: 听错. 了 follows 错 or ends the sentence, and the English order wrongly-heard does not exist.

items.src_py: tā bǎ zāng yī fu xǐ le
items.task: Say the clothes were washed CLEAN.
items.zh: 他把脏衣服洗干净了。
items.py: tā bǎ zāng yī fu xǐ gān jìng le
items.en: He washed the dirty clothes clean.
items.why: 干净 attaches straight after 洗 with no 得 or 很 between them, and 了 follows the pair.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ yào dōu chī le
items.task: Say none is LEFT (use 光).
items.zh: 我把药都吃光了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ yào dōu chī guāng le
items.en: I've taken all of the medicine; none is left.
items.why: 光 attaches straight after 吃 and says none is left. 了 closes the sentence and cannot sit between 吃 and 光.

items.src_py: bǎo bao shuì jiào le
items.task: Say the baby fell asleep.
items.zh: 宝宝睡着了。
items.py: bǎo bao shuì zháo le
items.en: The baby has fallen asleep.
items.why: 睡觉 means go to bed or sleep as an activity. The result 着 (zháo) replaces 觉 and gives 睡着, fallen asleep. 睡觉着 does not exist.

items.s: 昨天的雪太大，我没看清楚路。
items.s_py: zuó tiān de xuě tài dà wǒ méi kàn qīng chu lù
items.zh: 昨天的雪太大，我没看清楚路。
items.py: zuó tiān de xuě tài dà wǒ méi kàn qīng chu lù
items.en: Yesterday the snow was so heavy that I could not see the road clearly.
items.why: Correct. 没 goes before the whole 看清楚 for a result that did not happen on one past occasion, and no 了 is needed.

items.s: 昨天晚上太热，我不睡着。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng tài rè wǒ bù shuì zháo
items.zh: 昨天晚上太热，我没睡着。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng tài rè wǒ méi shuì zháo
items.en: It was so hot last night that I did not fall asleep.
items.why: 昨天 marks a past event, so the result 睡着 is negated with 没. 不睡着 does not exist as a past negative.

items.s: 他吃药总是不吃完，所以病一直不好。
items.s_py: tā chī yào zǒng shì bù chī wán suǒ yǐ bìng yì zhí bù hǎo
items.zh: 他吃药总是不吃完，所以病一直不好。
items.py: tā chī yào zǒng shì bù chī wán suǒ yǐ bìng yì zhí bù hǎo
items.en: He never finishes his medicine, so his illness never gets better.
items.why: Correct. 不 before verb + result is right for a habit, and 总是 marks that this is a general pattern and not one past event.

items.s: 我找了一个下午，也没找到了体温计。
items.s_py: wǒ zhǎo le yī gè xià wǔ yě méi zhǎo dào le tǐ wēn jì
items.zh: 我找了一个下午，也没找到体温计。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le yī gè xià wǔ yě méi zhǎo dào tǐ wēn jì
items.en: I searched all afternoon and still didn't find the thermometer.
items.why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 cannot be added after 找到. It is 没找到, not 没找到了.

items.s: 医生放药方在桌子上了。
items.s_py: yī shēng fàng yào fāng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.zh: 医生把药方放在桌子上了。
items.py: yī shēng bǎ yào fāng fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
items.en: The doctor put the prescription on the table.
items.why: 放在 must be followed at once by the place, so the prescription cannot come after the verb. It moves in front with 把.

items.s: 妈妈把感冒药都放在高的地方了。
items.s_py: mā ma bǎ gǎn mào yào dōu fàng zài gāo de dì fāng le
items.zh: 妈妈把感冒药都放在高的地方了。
items.py: mā ma bǎ gǎn mào yào dōu fàng zài gāo de dì fāng le
items.en: Mum has put all the cold medicine somewhere high.
items.why: Correct. 放在 is followed at once by the place 高的地方, and the medicine is fronted with 把. 了 ends the sentence.

items.s: 昨天太热，我一晚上没睡觉着。
items.s_py: zuó tiān tài rè wǒ yī wǎn shàng méi shuì jiào zháo
items.zh: 昨天太热，我一晚上没睡着。
items.py: zuó tiān tài rè wǒ yī wǎn shàng méi shuì zháo
items.en: It was so hot yesterday that I couldn't fall asleep all night.
items.why: The result 着 (zháo) attaches to 睡 and 觉 is dropped. 睡觉着 does not exist.

items.s: 雨停以后，我们看了见彩虹。
items.s_py: yǔ tíng yǐ hòu wǒ men kàn le jiàn cǎi hóng
items.zh: 雨停以后，我们看见了彩虹。
items.py: yǔ tíng yǐ hòu wǒ men kàn jiàn le cǎi hóng
items.en: After the rain stopped, we saw a rainbow.
items.why: 了 never goes between a verb and its result. 看见 stays together and 了 follows it.

items.s: 这份天气预报我看完了，可是没看懂。
items.s_py: zhè fèn tiān qì yù bào wǒ kàn wán le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
items.zh: 这份天气预报我看完了，可是没看懂。
items.py: zhè fèn tiān qì yù bào wǒ kàn wán le kě shì méi kàn dǒng
items.en: I finished reading this weather forecast, but I didn't understand it.
items.why: Correct. 看完 and 看懂 are different results of 看: reached the end versus understood. The second is negated with 没 and has no 了.

items.s: 我把鞋子擦了干净再进屋。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ xié zi cā le gān jìng zài jìn wū
items.zh: 我把鞋子擦干净再进屋。
items.py: wǒ bǎ xié zi cā gān jìng zài jìn wū
items.en: I wipe my shoes clean before going in.
items.why: 干净 attaches straight after 擦. 了 cannot come between a verb and its result.

items.s: 今年夏天特别热，我们一家人把冰箱里的西瓜吃光了。
items.s_py: jīn nián xià tiān tè bié rè wǒ men yī jiā rén bǎ bīng xiāng lǐ de xī gua chī guāng le
items.zh: 今年夏天特别热，我们一家人把冰箱里的西瓜吃光了。
items.py: jīn nián xià tiān tè bié rè wǒ men yī jiā rén bǎ bīng xiāng lǐ de xī gua chī guāng le
items.en: This summer was especially hot, and our whole family ate up all the watermelon in the fridge.
items.why: Correct. 吃光 says none is left, with the watermelon fronted by 把. 了 closes the sentence.

items.s: 请你翻译这张药方成中文。
items.s_py: qǐng nǐ fān yì zhè zhāng yào fāng chéng zhōng wén
items.zh: 请你把这张药方翻译成中文。
items.py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè zhāng yào fāng fān yì chéng zhōng wén
items.en: Please translate this prescription into Chinese.
items.why: 成 must be followed at once by the new form 中文, so the prescription cannot sit between 翻译 and 成. It moves in front with 把.

items.s: 这个问题你答对了，可是药名你还是记错了。
items.s_py: zhè ge wèn tí nǐ dá duì le kě shì yào míng nǐ hái shi jì cuò le
items.zh: 这个问题你答对了，可是药名你还是记错了。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí nǐ dá duì le kě shì yào míng nǐ hái shi jì cuò le
items.en: You answered this question correctly, but you still got the name of the medicine wrong.
items.why: Correct. 对 and 错 both attach straight after their verbs, and 了 follows each result.

items.s: 医生的话你听懂没有了？
items.s_py: yī shēng de huà nǐ tīng dǒng méi yǒu le
items.zh: 医生的话你听懂了没有？
items.py: yī shēng de huà nǐ tīng dǒng le méi yǒu
items.en: Did you understand what the doctor said?
items.why: In the 了没有 question, 了 comes right after the result and 没有 is the last word. 没有了 reverses them.

items.s: 你看见窗外的雪了没有？
items.s_py: nǐ kàn jiàn chuāng wài de xuě le méi yǒu
items.zh: 你看见窗外的雪了没有？
items.py: nǐ kàn jiàn chuāng wài de xuě le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you seen the snow outside the window?
items.why: Correct. Verb + result + object + 了没有 is a standard question. 了 follows the whole 看见 chunk and 没有 ends the sentence.

items.s: 冬天到了，他学了会滑冰。
items.s_py: dōng tiān dào le tā xué le huì huá bīng
items.zh: 冬天到了，他学会了滑冰。
items.py: dōng tiān dào le tā xué huì le huá bīng
items.en: Winter has come, and he has learned to skate.
items.why: 会 is the result of 学, so 了 cannot come between them. It goes after 学会.

items.s: 我把雨伞忘了在公共汽车上。
items.s_py: wǒ bǎ yǔ sǎn wàng le zài gōng gòng qì chē shàng
items.zh: 我把雨伞忘在公共汽车上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ yǔ sǎn wàng zài gōng gòng qì chē shàng le
items.en: I left my umbrella on the bus.
items.why: 了 never goes between a verb and 在. 忘在 stays together, followed at once by the place, and 了 goes at the end.

items.s: 雪下得太大，我们没看见路，就停下来了。
items.s_py: xuě xià de tài dà wǒ men méi kàn jiàn lù jiù tíng xià lái le
items.zh: 雪下得太大，我们没看见路，就停下来了。
items.py: xuě xià de tài dà wǒ men méi kàn jiàn lù jiù tíng xià lái le
items.en: The snow was falling so heavily that we couldn't see the road, so we stopped.
items.why: Correct. 没看见路 needs no 了, because 没 already says the result did not happen. The later 停下来了 is a separate event with its own 了.

items.s: 护士错念了我的名字。
items.s_py: hù shi cuò niàn le wǒ de míng zi
items.zh: 护士念错了我的名字。
items.py: hù shi niàn cuò le wǒ de míng zi
items.en: The nurse read out my name wrongly.
items.why: 错 is a result and must come right after the verb: 念错. The English order wrongly-read does not exist.

items.s: 你不说清楚症状，医生怎么知道你哪里不舒服？
items.s_py: nǐ bù shuō qīng chu zhèng zhuàng yī shēng zěn me zhī dào nǐ nǎ lǐ bù shū fu
items.zh: 你不说清楚症状，医生怎么知道你哪里不舒服？
items.py: nǐ bù shuō qīng chu zhèng zhuàng yī shēng zěn me zhī dào nǐ nǎ lǐ bù shū fu
items.en: If you don't describe your symptoms clearly, how would the doctor know where you feel unwell?
items.why: Correct. 不 before verb + result is right for an if-not condition, as in 不说清楚. It is not a past negative, so 没 is not needed.

items.zh: 他洗完澡就去踢球了。
items.py: tā xǐ wán zǎo jiù qù tī qiú le
items.en: He went off to play football as soon as he'd had a shower.
items.why: 洗澡 takes the result after 洗: 洗完澡. 就 links it to the next action, and the final 了 closes the whole sentence.

items.src: 孩子们已经把球场打扫干净了。
items.src_py: hái zi men yǐ jīng bǎ qiú chǎng dǎ sǎo gān jìng le
items.task: Turn it into a question with 了吗.
items.zh: 孩子们已经把球场打扫干净了吗？
items.py: hái zi men yǐ jīng bǎ qiú chǎng dǎ sǎo gān jìng le ma
items.en: Have the children already cleaned the sports ground?
items.why: 吗 is added at the end and the 把 pattern stays as it is.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn wán le nà běn shū
items.task: Put the book first, as the topic.
items.zh: 那本书我看完了。
items.py: nà běn shū wǒ kàn wán le
items.en: I've finished that book.
items.why: The fronted object leaves 看完 together, and the 了 moves to the end.

items.q: 那家店的位置我还没找___，你能发给我地址吗？
items.zh: 那家店的位置我还没找到，你能发给我地址吗？
items.py: nà jiā diàn de wèi zhì wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào nǐ néng fā gěi wǒ dì zhǐ ma
items.en: I haven't found that shop's location yet. Can you send me the address?
items.why: 还没找到 means the search has not yet reached its target. 完 and 会 do not describe finding something.

items.s: 你不说清楚，我怎么知道你要去哪儿？
items.zh: 你不说清楚，我怎么知道你要去哪儿？
items.py: nǐ bù shuō qīng chǔ wǒ zěn me zhī dào nǐ yào qù nǎ r
items.en: If you don't say it clearly, how would I know where you're going?
items.why: 不 + verb + result is right for 'if you don't…'. 没 is for a past result that failed to happen, which is not what this is.

items.q: 请把门打___，我们要进体育馆了。
items.zh: 请把门打开，我们要进体育馆了。
items.py: qǐng bǎ mén dǎ kāi wǒ men yào jìn tǐ yù guǎn le
items.en: Please open the door, we're going into the gym.
items.why: 打开 means to open. 住 would mean holding or stopping the door, and 掉 and 走 describe getting rid of or taking away something.

items.s: 我买得错了球票，日期不对。
items.s_py: wǒ mǎi de cuò le qiú piào rì qī bú duì
items.zh: 我买错了球票，日期不对。
items.py: wǒ mǎi cuò le qiú piào rì qī bú duì
items.en: I bought the wrong match tickets, the date is wrong.
items.why: 错 attaches straight to the verb as 买错了球票. Inserting 得 turns it into a different, unusable pattern.

items.q: 我把这本地图册还___图书馆了。
items.zh: 我把这本地图册还给图书馆了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zhè běn dì tú cè huán gěi tú shū guǎn le
items.en: I returned this atlas to the library.
items.why: 还给 plus the receiver means to give something back to someone. 在 would need a place and 成 a new form.

items.zh: 我看完了那场比赛。
items.py: wǒ kàn wán le nà chǎng bǐ sài
items.en: I've finished watching that match.
items.why: The object comes after the whole 看完了, or goes to the front as the topic. It cannot stand between 看 and 完.

items.q: 地铁里太吵，我刚才没听___广播，下一站是哪里？
items.zh: 地铁里太吵，我刚才没听清楚广播，下一站是哪里？
items.py: dì tiě lǐ tài chǎo wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng chǔ guǎng bō xià yī zhàn shì nǎ lǐ
items.en: The subway is so noisy that I didn't hear the announcement clearly. Where is the next stop?
items.why: Noise is a hearing problem, so the result is 听清楚, not an understanding problem. 懂 would mean the words were audible but not understood.

items.q: 我们去的时候，球场的门还___打开。
items.zh: 我们去的时候，球场的门还没打开。
items.py: wǒ men qù de shí hòu qiú chǎng de mén hái méi dǎ kāi
items.en: When we got there, the gate of the sports ground hadn't been opened yet.
items.why: 还没 plus verb and result says the result has not yet happened. 不 would turn it into a refusal or a habit.

items.q: 教练讲的战术我都听___了，下一场一定能用上。
items.zh: 教练讲的战术我都听懂了，下一场一定能用上。
items.py: jiào liàn jiǎng de zhàn shù wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le xià yī chǎng yí dìng néng yòng shàng
items.en: I understood all the tactics the coach explained, and I'll definitely use them in the next match.
items.why: 听懂 means you understood what you heard. 见 only means the sound registered, and 会 and 住 do not fit 听 in this meaning.

items.s: 不好意思，我看错时间了，比赛已经开始了。
items.zh: 不好意思，我看错时间了，比赛已经开始了。
items.py: bù hǎo yì sī wǒ kàn cuò shí jiān le bǐ sài yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le
items.en: Sorry, I misread the time, and the match has already started.
items.why: 错 sits right after 看 and 了 follows it. This is the normal way to say you got something wrong.

items.q: 比赛结束了，请大家把垃圾带___，不要留在球场。
items.zh: 比赛结束了，请大家把垃圾带走，不要留在球场。
items.py: bǐ sài jié shù le qǐng dà jiā bǎ lā jī dài zǒu bú yào liú zài qiú chǎng
items.en: The match is over. Please take your rubbish away and don't leave it on the field.
items.why: 带走 means to carry something off with you. 掉 means getting rid of something and does not follow 带 here, and 光 would mean none left.

items.zh: 他没听清楚教练的话。
items.py: tā méi tīng qīng chǔ jiào liàn de huà
items.en: He didn't hear the coach's words clearly.
items.why: 没 comes before 听清楚 and 了 is dropped. The object follows the pair or goes to the front.

items.src_py: wǒ bǎ shuǐ hú fàng zài bāo lǐ le
items.task: Say you have not done it yet.
items.zh: 我还没把水壶放在包里。
items.py: wǒ hái méi bǎ shuǐ hú fàng zài bāo lǐ
items.en: I haven't put the water bottle in my bag yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 把, and the 了 of the original is dropped.

items.q: 我把车钥匙落___出租车上了。
items.zh: 我把车钥匙落在出租车上了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ chē yào shi luò zài chū zū chē shàng le
items.en: I left my car key in the taxi.
items.why: 落在 plus a place says where the key was left. 给 needs a receiver, and 出租车上 is a place, not a person.

items.s: 我把自行车停在了地铁站旁边。
items.zh: 我把自行车停在了地铁站旁边。
items.py: wǒ bǎ zì xíng chē tíng zài le dì tiě zhàn páng biān
items.en: I parked my bike next to the subway station.
items.why: 了 may follow 在 in the 把 pattern: 停在了. It only cannot go between 停 and 在.

items.q: 他每天练习，三个月就学___弹吉他了。
items.zh: 他每天练习，三个月就学会弹吉他了。
items.py: tā měi tiān liàn xí sān gè yuè jiù xué huì dàn jí tā le
items.en: He practised every day and learned to play the guitar in three months.
items.why: 学会 plus an activity means you can now do it. 到 and 见 reach a target or register a sight, and 住 means holding something, so none of them says 'acquired the skill'.

items.src_py: wǒ zhǎo dào le yào shi
items.task: Put the 了 at the end of the sentence.
items.zh: 我找到钥匙了。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo dào yào shi le
items.en: I've found my keys.
items.why: 了 may follow the result or end the sentence, but never sit between 找 and 到.

items.zh: 你听懂老师的话了吗？
items.py: nǐ tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà le ma
items.en: Did you understand what the teacher said?
items.why: Verb and result stay together, the object follows or is fronted, and 了吗 closes the yes-no question.

items.s: 他昨天太累了，一上床就睡着了。
items.zh: 他昨天太累了，一上床就睡着了。
items.py: tā zuó tiān tài lèi le yī shàng chuáng jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: He was so tired yesterday that he fell asleep the moment he got into bed.
items.why: 睡着 (zháo) means fell asleep, and 了 follows the result. This is the standard form.

items.src_py: wǒ rēng diào le nà xiē jiù qiú xié
items.task: Rewrite with 把.
items.zh: 我把那些旧球鞋扔掉了。
items.py: wǒ bǎ nà xiē jiù qiú xié rēng diào le
items.en: I threw away those old sports shoes.
items.why: 把 fronts the object and 扔掉 keeps its result 掉 and 了.

items.s: 我吃饭完了。
items.s_py: wǒ chī fàn wán le
items.zh: 我吃完饭了。
items.py: wǒ chī wán fàn le
items.en: I've finished eating.
items.why: 吃完 is one unit. The object 饭 cannot come between 吃 and 完.

items.zh: 我找到工作了。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo dào gōng zuò le
items.en: I've found a job.
items.why: 了 goes after the result or at the end of the sentence, never between 找 and 到. Here both are possible.

items.zh: 你的球拍找到了没有？
items.py: nǐ de qiú pāi zhǎo dào le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you found your racket?
items.why: The topic 你的球拍 comes first, then 找到, and the question ends in 了没有. 找 and 到 stay together.

items.src_py: tā xiě wán le jīn tiān de zuò yè
items.task: Put the homework first, as the topic.
items.zh: 今天的作业他写完了。
items.py: jīn tiān de zuò yè tā xiě wán le
items.en: He has finished today's homework.
items.why: The topic comes first, 写完 stays together, and 了 closes the sentence.

items.s: 我们看完比赛就去吃夜宵吧。
items.zh: 我们看完比赛就去吃夜宵吧。
items.py: wǒ men kàn wán bǐ sài jiù qù chī yè xiāo ba
items.en: Let's go and get a late-night snack after we've watched the match.
items.why: 看完比赛 puts the result right after the verb and the object after it. 就 links the two actions and no 了 is needed.

items.q: 你的跑鞋买___了吗？
items.zh: 你的跑鞋买到了吗？
items.py: nǐ de pǎo xié mǎi dào le ma
items.en: Did you manage to buy your running shoes?
items.why: 买到 asks whether the purchase succeeded. 完 and 会 do not describe getting something, and 懂 is about understanding.

items.q: 球衣上的泥太多，我洗了三遍才洗___。
items.zh: 球衣上的泥太多，我洗了三遍才洗干净。
items.py: qiú yī shàng de ní tài duō wǒ xǐ le sān biàn cái xǐ gān jìng
items.en: There was so much mud on the jersey that I had to wash it three times before it was clean.
items.why: 洗干净 says the washing ended with the jersey clean. 错 and 会 do not describe clothes, and 住 means holding or stopping.

items.q: 天太黑，我把“大”看___“太”了。
items.zh: 天太黑，我把“大”看成“太”了。
items.py: tiān tài hēi wǒ bǎ dà kàn chéng tài le
items.en: It was so dark that I mistook the character 大 for 太.
items.why: 看成 plus the new form means mistaking one thing for another. 看错 is a result by itself and cannot take 太 after it.

items.q: 小李把羽毛球拍借___我，我才能参加比赛。
items.zh: 小李把羽毛球拍借给我，我才能参加比赛。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ bǎ yǔ máo qiú pāi jiè gěi wǒ wǒ cái néng cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: Xiao Li lent me his badminton racket, so I could take part in the match.
items.why: 借给 plus a person says who receives the racket. 在 would need a place after it, and 成 would need a new form.

items.s: 教练把我们分了成两队。
items.s_py: jiào liàn bǎ wǒ men fēn le chéng liǎng duì
items.zh: 教练把我们分成两队。
items.py: jiào liàn bǎ wǒ men fēn chéng liǎng duì
items.en: The coach divided us into two teams.
items.why: 了 cannot sit between the verb and 成. It may follow 成 (分成了两队) or be left out.

items.s: 我吃完饭就去公园跑步。
items.zh: 我吃完饭就去公园跑步。
items.py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: I'll go running in the park as soon as I've eaten.
items.why: In 'after A, then B' the first action 吃完饭 needs no 了. It is correct as it stands.

items.s: 你看懂这张地图了没有？
items.zh: 你看懂这张地图了没有？
items.py: nǐ kàn dǒng zhè zhāng dì tú le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you understood this map yet?
items.why: The 了没有 form is correct: verb, result, object, 了, then 没有 at the end.

items.s: 我找了半天，终于找了那家书店。
items.s_py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo le nà jiā shū diàn
items.zh: 我找了半天，终于找到那家书店。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào nà jiā shū diàn
items.en: I searched for ages and finally found that bookshop.
items.why: 找 only says you were looking. 'Found' needs the result 到.

items.zh: 我还没找到地铁站。
items.py: wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào dì tiě zhàn
items.en: I still haven't found the subway station.
items.why: 还没 goes before the whole 找到 and there is no 了. The object follows the result or is fronted.

items.q: 昨天我在球场___找到小王，他没来。
items.zh: 昨天我在球场没找到小王，他没来。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ zài qiú chǎng méi zhǎo dào xiǎo wáng tā méi lái
items.en: I didn't find Xiao Wang at the sports ground yesterday. He didn't come.
items.why: 昨天 fixes a past event whose result failed, so it takes 没. 不找到 does not describe a past attempt, and 别 is a command.

items.zh: 教练把我们分成了三个小组。
items.py: jiào liàn bǎ wǒ men fēn chéng le sān gè xiǎo zǔ
items.en: The coach divided us into three groups.
items.why: 分成 needs the new form right after it, so the thing divided goes in front with 把. 了 may follow 成.

items.q: 我们走了半个小时，还没走___这条街，天就黑了。
items.zh: 我们走了半个小时，还没走完这条街，天就黑了。
items.py: wǒ men zǒu le bàn gè xiǎo shí hái méi zǒu wán zhè tiáo jiē tiān jiù hēi le
items.en: We walked for half an hour and hadn't finished walking this street before it got dark.
items.why: 走完 means walking the whole length of the street, and 还没 says that has not yet happened. 会 and 懂 do not describe walking.

items.q: 昨天的足球赛我___看完，太困了，十点就睡了。
items.zh: 昨天的足球赛我没看完，太困了，十点就睡了。
items.py: zuó tiān de zú qiú sài wǒ méi kàn wán tài kùn le shí diǎn jiù shuì le
items.en: I didn't watch the whole football match yesterday. I was too tired and went to bed at ten.
items.why: 昨天 fixes the time in the past, and a result that did not happen is negated with 没. 不 would not fit a finished past event.

items.q: 地铁里太吵了，你说什么？我没听___。
items.zh: 地铁里太吵了，你说什么？我没听见。
items.py: dì tiě lǐ tài chǎo le nǐ shuō shén me wǒ méi tīng jiàn
items.en: The subway is so noisy. What did you say? I didn't hear you.
items.why: In a noisy place the problem is that the sound did not register, which is 听见. 懂 would mean you heard it but did not understand the words.

items.q: 周末逛街，我把这个月的钱都花___了。
items.zh: 周末逛街，我把这个月的钱都花光了。
items.py: zhōu mò guàng jiē wǒ bǎ zhè ge yuè de qián dōu huā guāng le
items.en: I went shopping on the weekend and spent all of this month's money.
items.why: 花光 means the money is all gone with none left. 走 means taken away by someone, and 住 and 开 do not describe money being spent.

items.q: 对不起，我走___路了，这不是去地铁站的路。
items.zh: 对不起，我走错路了，这不是去地铁站的路。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ zǒu cuò lù le zhè bú shì qù dì tiě zhàn de lù
items.en: Sorry, I took the wrong road. This isn't the way to the subway station.
items.why: 走错路 puts the result 错 straight after the verb. 对 would say the road was right, which contradicts the second clause.

items.q: 比赛马上开始了，你的球鞋准备___了吗？
items.zh: 比赛马上开始了，你的球鞋准备好了吗？
items.py: bǐ sài mǎ shàng kāi shǐ le nǐ de qiú xié zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma
items.en: The match is about to start. Are your sports shoes ready?
items.why: 准备 takes 好 for 'ready to go'. 会 would mean you have learned to prepare, and 懂 and 见 are about understanding and seeing, which makes no sense for shoes.

items.src_py: nǐ zhǎo dào shǒu jī le
items.task: Ask with 了没有.
items.zh: 你找到手机了没有？
items.py: nǐ zhǎo dào shǒu jī le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you found your phone?
items.why: The 了没有 form puts 了 after the object and ends with 没有.

items.q: 请把自行车停___门口，别挡路。
items.zh: 请把自行车停在门口，别挡路。
items.py: qǐng bǎ zì xíng chē tíng zài mén kǒu bié dǎng lù
items.en: Please park your bike at the entrance, don't block the way.
items.why: 停在 plus a place says where the bike ends up. 给 needs a person who receives it, and 成 needs a new form.

items.q: 这张旧照片没用了，我把它删___了。
items.zh: 这张旧照片没用了，我把它删掉了。
items.py: zhè zhāng jiù zhào piān méi yòng le wǒ bǎ tā shān diào le
items.en: This old photo is useless, so I deleted it.
items.why: 删掉 means to remove something. 走 means taken away by someone, 光 would need many photos to be used up, and 住 means held in place.

items.q: 他的钓鱼竿修___了，周末可以去河边钓鱼了。
items.zh: 他的钓鱼竿修好了，周末可以去河边钓鱼了。
items.py: tā de diào yú gān xiū hǎo le zhōu mò kě yǐ qù hé biān diào yú le
items.en: His fishing rod is fixed, so he can go fishing by the river this weekend.
items.why: 修好 means repaired and working again, which is the point of the sentence. 会 and 懂 would turn the repair into a skill or an understanding, and 住 means holding something fixed in place.

items.s: 我听了懂老师的话。
items.s_py: wǒ tīng le dǒng lǎo shī de huà
items.zh: 我听懂了老师的话。
items.py: wǒ tīng dǒng le lǎo shī de huà
items.en: I understood what the teacher said.
items.why: 了 never goes between the verb and its result. It follows 懂.

items.q: 我们的比赛路线他还没记___，怎么带队？
items.zh: 我们的比赛路线他还没记住，怎么带队？
items.py: wǒ men de bǐ sài lù xiàn tā hái méi jì zhù zěn me dài duì
items.en: He hasn't memorised our race route yet, so how can he lead the team?
items.why: 记住 means to remember firmly, and 还没 says it has not yet happened. 会 and 见 do not follow 记.

items.q: 这张城市地图我研究了很久，终于看___了。
items.zh: 这张城市地图我研究了很久，终于看懂了。
items.py: zhè zhāng chéng shì dì tú wǒ yán jiū le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú kàn dǒng le
items.en: I studied this city map for a long time and finally understood it.
items.why: After long study, 看懂 means you now understand the map. 错 would mean misreading it, and 见 would only say you saw it.

items.q: 我学___打网球了，周末可以跟你比赛。
items.zh: 我学会打网球了，周末可以跟你比赛。
items.py: wǒ xué huì dǎ wǎng qiú le zhōu mò kě yǐ gēn nǐ bǐ sài
items.en: I've learned to play tennis, so I can play a match with you this weekend.
items.why: 学会 means you studied until you can do it, which is why a match is now possible. 懂 is for understanding information, and 见 and 走 do not attach to 学.

items.zh: 我们吃完饭去跑步吧。
items.py: wǒ men chī wán fàn qù pǎo bù ba
items.en: Let's go for a run after we eat.
items.why: 吃饭 splits and the result follows only the verb: 吃完饭. The first of two actions in a row carries no 了.

items.s: 我找了半天才找到那家新开的球馆。
items.zh: 我找了半天才找到那家新开的球馆。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān cái zhǎo dào nà jiā xīn kāi de qiú guǎn
items.en: I searched for ages before I found that newly opened sports hall.
items.why: 找了半天 describes the time spent looking, and 找到 gives the result. 了 after the first 找 is fine here.

items.s: 孩子玩了一天，晚上很快就睡觉着了。
items.s_py: hái zi wán le yī tiān wǎn shàng hěn kuài jiù shuì jiào zhe le
items.zh: 孩子玩了一天，晚上很快就睡着了。
items.py: hái zi wán le yī tiān wǎn shàng hěn kuài jiù shuì zháo le
items.en: The child played all day and fell asleep quickly in the evening.
items.why: 睡着 is the result form, and 觉 is dropped: 睡觉着 does not exist.

items.q: 昨天看球赛看到半夜，今天上课差点睡___。
items.zh: 昨天看球赛看到半夜，今天上课差点睡着。
items.py: zuó tiān kàn qiú sài kàn dào bàn yè jīn tiān shàng kè chà diǎn shuì zháo
items.en: I watched the match until midnight yesterday, and today I nearly fell asleep in class.
items.why: 睡着 (zháo) means to fall asleep. 住, 掉 and 走 do not combine with 睡 in any sensible way.

items.src_py: wǒ zuò wán zuò yè le
items.task: Say it is not finished yet.
items.zh: 我还没做完作业。
items.py: wǒ hái méi zuò wán zuò yè
items.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
items.why: 还没 goes before 做完, and 作业 stays after the whole pair. 了 is dropped.

items.zh: 他跑完一万米了。
items.py: tā pǎo wán yī wàn mǐ le
items.en: He has run ten thousand metres.
items.why: 了 closes the sentence or follows the result 完, never splits 跑 and 完. The counted object may follow the result or be fronted.

items.q: 我在地铁口看___一家新开的羽毛球馆。
items.zh: 我在地铁口看见一家新开的羽毛球馆。
items.py: wǒ zài dì tiě kǒu kàn jiàn yī jiā xīn kāi de yǔ máo qiú guǎn
items.en: I saw a newly opened badminton hall at the subway exit.
items.why: 看见 says the sight registered, which is exactly 'I saw'. 懂 would mean understanding it and 完 means finishing, neither of which suits noticing a building.

items.zh: 我没看完今天的比赛。
items.py: wǒ méi kàn wán jīn tiān de bǐ sài
items.en: I didn't watch all of today's match.
items.why: 没 goes before the whole 看完, and the object follows it or is fronted. 了 is dropped.

items.q: 雨太大，伞被风吹___了。
items.zh: 雨太大，伞被风吹走了。
items.py: yǔ tài dà sǎn bèi fēng chuī zǒu le
items.en: The rain was heavy and the umbrella was blown away by the wind.
items.why: 吹走 means the wind carried the umbrella off. 住 would mean holding it in place, and 光 would mean no umbrella was left at all.

items.q: 我的自行车被人骑___了，只好坐地铁去公园。
items.zh: 我的自行车被人骑走了，只好坐地铁去公园。
items.py: wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi rén qí zǒu le zhǐ hǎo zuò dì tiě qù gōng yuán
items.en: Someone rode my bike away, so I had to take the subway to the park.
items.why: 骑走 means someone left riding it, so the bike is gone. 掉 means removed or discarded, not ridden off, and 光 means nothing left.

items.q: 教练把我们十二个人分___三队，每队四个人。
items.zh: 教练把我们十二个人分成三队，每队四个人。
items.py: jiào liàn bǎ wǒ men shí èr gè rén fēn chéng sān duì měi duì sì gè rén
items.en: The coach divided the twelve of us into three teams of four.
items.why: 分成 plus a number of groups means divided into those groups. 在 needs a place and 给 needs a person.

items.q: 电影院在哪儿？我问了好几个路人，才终于打听___。
items.zh: 电影院在哪儿？我问了好几个路人，才终于打听到。
items.py: diàn yǐng yuàn zài nǎ r wǒ wèn le hǎo jǐ gè lù rén cái zhōng yú dǎ tīng dào
items.en: Where is the cinema? I asked several passers-by before I finally found out.
items.why: 打听到 means the enquiry reached its target: you got the information. 见 is only for perception verbs, and 懂 and 完 do not describe obtaining information.

items.q: 你儿子游泳学___了吗？现在能自己游了吗？
items.zh: 你儿子游泳学会了吗？现在能自己游了吗？
items.py: nǐ ér zi yóu yǒng xué huì le ma xiàn zài néng zì jǐ yóu le ma
items.en: Has your son learned to swim? Can he swim by himself now?
items.why: 学会了吗 asks whether he has gained the skill, which the follow-up question confirms. 到, 懂 and 走 do not describe learning a skill.

items.q: 我昨天买___两张今晚的球赛票。
items.zh: 我昨天买到两张今晚的球赛票。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi dào liǎng zhāng jīn wǎn de qiú sài piào
items.en: Yesterday I managed to get two tickets for tonight's match.
items.why: 买到 says the buying succeeded: you got the tickets. 完 and 会 do not describe obtaining something, and 懂 is only for understanding.

items.s: 昨天的篮球赛我不看完。
items.s_py: zuó tiān de lán qiú sài wǒ bù kàn wán
items.zh: 昨天的篮球赛我没看完。
items.py: zuó tiān de lán qiú sài wǒ méi kàn wán
items.en: I didn't watch all of yesterday's basketball game.
items.why: 昨天 puts the event in the past, so the failed result needs 没. 不 + verb + result is not the past negative.

items.q: 他踢球的时候把球踢___方向了，所以没进。
items.zh: 他踢球的时候把球踢错方向了，所以没进。
items.py: tā tī qiú de shí hòu bǎ qiú tī cuò fāng xiàng le suǒ yǐ méi jìn
items.en: When he kicked the ball he kicked it in the wrong direction, so it didn't go in.
items.why: The ball missing the goal means the direction was wrong: 踢错. 对 and 好 would say it went well, and 干净 only describes cleanliness.

items.q: 球场里人声太大，教练的话我一句也没听___，只好看他的手势。
items.zh: 球场里人声太大，教练的话我一句也没听见，只好看他的手势。
items.py: qiú chǎng lǐ rén shēng tài dà jiào liàn de huà wǒ yī jù yě méi tīng jiàn zhǐ hǎo kàn tā de shǒu shì
items.en: The crowd was so loud that I didn't hear a single word the coach said, so I had to watch his gestures.
items.why: Noise stops the words from registering, so the result is 听见. 懂 would suggest the words were audible but not understood, and the sentence blames the noise.

items.q: 我找了半天，终于找___那家书店了。
items.zh: 我找了半天，终于找到那家书店了。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào nà jiā shū diàn le
items.en: I searched for ages and finally found that bookshop.
items.why: 找 alone only says you were looking. Finding something is 找到, where 到 means the search reached its target. 完, 懂 and 会 do not describe a successful search.

items.q: 我昨天为了抢演唱会的票熬到半夜，一直到两点才睡___。
items.zh: 我昨天为了抢演唱会的票熬到半夜，一直到两点才睡着。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wèi le qiǎng yǎn chàng huì de piào áo dào bàn yè yì zhí dào liǎng diǎn cái shuì zháo
items.en: Yesterday I stayed up past midnight to get concert tickets and didn't fall asleep until two.
items.why: 睡着 (zháo) is the result 'fell asleep'. 住, 开 and 掉 cannot follow 睡.

items.s: 昨天的球赛我没看完。
items.zh: 昨天的球赛我没看完。
items.py: zuó tiān de qiú sài wǒ méi kàn wán
items.en: I didn't watch all of yesterday's match.
items.why: 没 before 看完 is the correct past negative and it takes no 了. Adding 了 would be the mistake.

items.q: 这道题你猜___了，奖品是一张演唱会的票，恭喜你！
items.zh: 这道题你猜对了，奖品是一张演唱会的票，恭喜你！
items.py: zhè dào tí nǐ cāi duì le jiǎng pǐn shì yī zhāng yǎn chàng huì de piào gōng xǐ nǐ
items.en: You guessed this question right, and the prize is a concert ticket. Congratulations!
items.why: 猜对 means the guess was right, which earns the prize and the congratulations. 错 would say the opposite.

items.zh: 请把球拍放在桌子上。
items.py: qǐng bǎ qiú pāi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
items.en: Please put the racket on the table.
items.why: 放在 needs the place right behind it, so the racket moves in front with 把.

items.zh: 我买到了两张音乐会的票。
items.py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng yīn yuè huì de piào
items.en: I managed to get two concert tickets.
items.why: With a counted object, 了 comes right after the result: 买到了. The object may also be fronted as the topic.

items.q: 教练的电话号码你要记___，比赛那天用得着。
items.zh: 教练的电话号码你要记住，比赛那天用得着。
items.py: jiào liàn de diàn huà hào mǎ nǐ yào jì zhù bǐ sài nà tiān yòng de zháo
items.en: You need to remember the coach's phone number, because you'll need it on match day.
items.why: 记住 means to fix something in your memory. 掉, 走 and 光 mean removed, taken away and used up, the opposite of keeping a number.

items.q: 教练讲的规则你们都听___了吗？
items.zh: 教练讲的规则你们都听懂了吗？
items.py: jiào liàn jiǎng de guī zé nǐ men dōu tīng dǒng le ma
items.en: Did you all understand the rules the coach explained?
items.why: 听懂了吗 asks whether you understood. 见 would ask whether you heard, and 完 would ask whether the coach had stopped talking.

items.q: 我在球场上没看___小王。
items.zh: 我在球场上没看见小王。
items.py: wǒ zài qiú chǎng shàng méi kàn jiàn xiǎo wáng
items.en: I didn't see Xiao Wang at the sports ground.
items.why: 看见 means the sight registered. 懂 would say you did not understand Xiao Wang, 完 would say you did not finish looking, and 会 does not follow 看 at all.

items.s: 你听懂没有了？
items.s_py: nǐ tīng dǒng méi yǒu le
items.zh: 你听懂了没有？
items.py: nǐ tīng dǒng le méi yǒu
items.en: Have you understood?
items.why: In the 了没有 question, 了 comes first and 没有 ends the sentence.

items.q: 昨天太兴奋了，我一晚上都没睡___。
items.zh: 昨天太兴奋了，我一晚上都没睡着。
items.py: zuó tiān tài xīng fèn le wǒ yī wǎn shàng dōu méi shuì zháo
items.en: I was too excited yesterday and didn't fall asleep all night.
items.why: 没睡着 (zháo) means sleep did not arrive. 懂, 完 and 错 cannot follow 睡.

items.q: 你的快递我昨天就收___了，谢谢你！
items.zh: 你的快递我昨天就收到了，谢谢你！
items.py: nǐ de kuài dì wǒ zuó tiān jiù shōu dào le xiè xiè nǐ
items.en: I received your parcel yesterday, thank you!
items.why: 收 plus 到 means the item reached you. 见 is only for seeing and hearing, so 收见 does not exist, and 懂 and 完 do not fit receiving.

items.src: 我买到了两张演唱会的票。
items.src_py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng yǎn chàng huì de piào
items.task: Put the tickets first, as the topic.
items.zh: 两张演唱会的票我买到了。
items.py: liǎng zhāng yǎn chàng huì de piào wǒ mǎi dào le
items.en: I managed to get two concert tickets.
items.why: Fronting the object leaves 买到 together, and 了 moves to the end.

items.s: 我没找到那家店了。
items.s_py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào nà jiā diàn le
items.zh: 我没找到那家店。
items.py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào nà jiā diàn
items.en: I didn't find that shop.
items.why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 is dropped.

items.zh: 我在窗口买到了两张票。
items.py: wǒ zài chuāng kǒu mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng piào
items.en: I got two tickets at the window.
items.why: 买到 is the result 'got', and with a counted object 了 follows it directly. The place phrase goes before the verb. 买 alone would only say you tried to buy.

items.q: 他说得太快，我没听___他的电话号码。
items.zh: 他说得太快，我没听清楚他的电话号码。
items.py: tā shuō de tài kuài wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ tā de diàn huà hào mǎ
items.en: He spoke too fast and I didn't catch his phone number clearly.
items.why: 没听清楚 says the number did not come through clearly. 完 and 会 do not describe hearing, and 听住 is not a word.

items.q: 我已经跑___五千米了，现在要休息一下。
items.zh: 我已经跑完五千米了，现在要休息一下。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng pǎo wán wǔ qiān mǐ le xiàn zài yào xiū xī yī xià
items.en: I've finished running five kilometres, and now I need a rest.
items.why: 完 says the run reached its end. 会 is for a skill you have learned, and 见 and 懂 belong to perceiving and understanding, so none of them fits a finished run.

items.s: 我在路上看见小李了。
items.zh: 我在路上看见小李了。
items.py: wǒ zài lù shàng kàn jiàn xiǎo lǐ le
items.en: I saw Xiao Li on the road.
items.why: 看见 gives the sight as a result, and 了 follows at the end. The sentence is complete and correct.

items.q: 你先在路口站___，红灯亮了。
items.zh: 你先在路口站住，红灯亮了。
items.py: nǐ xiān zài lù kǒu zhàn zhù hóng dēng liàng le
items.en: Stop at the intersection first, the light has turned red.
items.why: 站住 means to stop and stand still. 走 and 掉 would mean leaving or being removed, which is the opposite of waiting at a red light.

items.q: 地址我写___了，快递送到别的街去了。
items.zh: 地址我写错了，快递送到别的街去了。
items.py: dì zhǐ wǒ xiě cuò le kuài dì sòng dào bié de jiē qù le
items.en: I wrote the address wrong, and the parcel went to another street.
items.why: The parcel going elsewhere shows the address was wrong, so 写错. 对, 好 and 清楚 would all describe a correct address.

items.q: 请把“体育场”翻译___英文。
items.zh: 请把“体育场”翻译成英文。
items.py: qǐng bǎ tǐ yù chǎng fān yì chéng yīng wén
items.en: Please translate 'sports ground' into English.
items.why: 翻译成 plus a language says what it is turned into. 在 would need a place and 给 would need a person.

items.q: 球赛打___了没有？我想关电视了。
items.zh: 球赛打完了没有？我想关电视了。
items.py: qiú sài dǎ wán le méi yǒu wǒ xiǎng guān diàn shì le
items.en: Is the match over? I want to turn the TV off.
items.why: 打完 asks whether the match has reached its end. 会 and 见 do not describe a match finishing.
